Syndra.name: Dark Sphere
Syndra.text: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

Syndra.name: Force of Will
Syndra.text: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.

Syndra.name: Scatter the Weak
Syndra.text: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

Syndra.name: Unleashed Power
Syndra.text: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

Syndra.name: Transcendent
Syndra.text: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional chargeForce of Will: Bonus true damage.Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targetsUnleashed Power: Executes low health targets

Jade_Kennen.name: Thundering Shuriken
Jade_Kennen.text: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of Storm to any opponent that it hits.

Jade_Kennen.name: Electrical Surge
Jade_Kennen.text: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

Jade_Kennen.name: Lightning Rush
Jade_Kennen.text: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units.  Any enemy unit he runs through takes damage and gets a Mark of the Storm.

Jade_Kennen.name: Slicing Maelstrom
Jade_Kennen.text: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at random nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

Jade_Kennen.name: Mark of the Storm
Jade_Kennen.text: Kennen marks enemies when hitting them with abilities. Once three marks are applied the target is stunned.

Shen.name: Twilight Assault
Shen.text: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

Shen.name: Spirit's Refuge
Shen.text: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

Shen.name: Shadow Dash
Shen.text: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

Shen.name: Stand United
Shen.text: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

Shen.name: Ki Barrier
Shen.text: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

TahmKench.name: Tongue Lash
TahmKench.text: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion.Applies a stack of  An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.

TahmKench.name: Abyssal Dive
TahmKench.text: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.

TahmKench.name: Thick Skin
TahmKench.text: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat.Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.

TahmKench.name: Devour
TahmKench.text: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.

TahmKench.name: An Acquired Taste
TahmKench.text: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.

Samira.name: Flair
Samira.text: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

Samira.name: Blade Whirl
Samira.text: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

Samira.name: Wild Rush
Samira.text: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.

Samira.name: Inferno Trigger
Samira.text: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

Samira.name: Daredevil Impulse
Samira.text: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

Jade_Lulu.name: Glitterlance
Jade_Lulu.text: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that heavily slows all enemies it hits. An enemy can only be damaged by one bolt.

Jade_Lulu.name: Whimsy
Jade_Lulu.text: If cast on an ally, grants them movement speed and ability power for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

Jade_Lulu.name: Help, Pix!
Jade_Lulu.text: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

Jade_Lulu.name: Wild Growth
Jade_Lulu.text: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

Jade_Lulu.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
Jade_Lulu.text: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

Yunara.name: Cultivation of Spirit
Yunara.text: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.

Yunara.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
Yunara.text: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.

Yunara.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
Yunara.text: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.

Yunara.name: Transcend One's Self
Yunara.text: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.

Yunara.name: Vow of the First Lands
Yunara.text: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

Khazix.name: Taste Their Fear
Khazix.text: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on Isolated targets. If he chooses to Evolve Reaper Claws, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against Isolated targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.

Khazix.name: Void Spike
Khazix.text: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to Evolve Spike Racks, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. Isolated targets are slowed for extra.

Khazix.name: Leap
Khazix.text: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to Evolve Wings, Leap's range increases and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.

Khazix.name: Void Assault
Khazix.text: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes Invisible, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to Evolve Adaptive Cloaking, Void Assault gains increased Invisibility duration, and an additional use.

Khazix.name: Unseen Threat
Khazix.text: Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets.When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.

Kalista.name: Pierce
Kalista.text: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

Kalista.name: Sentinel
Kalista.text: Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target. Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.

Kalista.name: Rend
Kalista.text: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

Kalista.name: Fate's Call
Kalista.text: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

Kalista.name: Martial Poise
Kalista.text: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

Rengar.name: Savagery
Rengar.text: Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.

Rengar.name: Battle Roar
Rengar.text: Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

Rengar.name: Bola Strike
Rengar.text: Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.Ferocity effect: roots the target.

Rengar.name: Thrill of the Hunt
Rengar.text: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

Rengar.name: Unseen Predator
Rengar.text: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

Xayah.name: Double Daggers
Xayah.text: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

Xayah.name: Deadly Plumage
Xayah.text: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

Xayah.name: Bladecaller
Xayah.text: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

Xayah.name: Featherstorm
Xayah.text: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.

Xayah.name: Clean Cuts
Xayah.text: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.

Vex.name: Mistral Bolt
Vex.text: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

Vex.name: Personal Space
Vex.text: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

Vex.name: Looming Darkness
Vex.text: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

Vex.name: Shadow Surge
Vex.text: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

Vex.name: Doom 'n Gloom
Vex.text: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

Jade_Skarner.name: Crystal Slash
Jade_Skarner.text: Skarner lashes out with his claws, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies and charging himself with Crystal Energy for several seconds if a unit is struck.  If he casts Crystal Slash again while powered by Crystal Energy, he deals bonus magic damage and slows all targets hit.

Jade_Skarner.name: Crystalline Exoskeleton
Jade_Skarner.text: Skarner gains a shield, and while the shield persists his movement speed and attack speed are both increased.

Jade_Skarner.name: Fracture
Jade_Skarner.text: Skarner summons a blast of crystalline energy which deals damage to enemies struck and marks them. Striking enemies will consume the mark to heal Skarner. Killing targets outright will also activate the heal.

Jade_Skarner.name: Impale
Jade_Skarner.text: Skarner suppresses an enemy champion and deals magic damage to it.  During this time, Skarner can move freely and will drag his helpless victim around with him.  When the effect ends, Skarner's target will be dealt additional damage.

Jade_Skarner.name: Energize
Jade_Skarner.text: Basic attacks reduce all ability cooldowns. This effect is stronger against champions.

Braum.name: Winter's Bite
Braum.text: Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, slowing and dealing magic damage.Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.

Braum.name: Stand Behind Me
Braum.text: Braum leaps to a target allied champion or minion. On arrival, Braum and the ally gain Armor and Magic Resist for a few seconds.

Braum.name: Unbreakable
Braum.text: Braum raises his shield in a direction for several seconds, intercepting all projectiles causing them to hit him and be destroyed. He negates the damage of the first attack completely and reduces the damage of all subsequent attacks from this direction.

Braum.name: Glacial Fissure
Braum.text: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him. A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.

Braum.name: Concussive Blows
Braum.text: Braum's basic attacks apply Concussive Blows. Once the first stack is applied, ally basic attacks also stack Concussive Blows. Upon reaching 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes magic damage. For the next few seconds they cannot receive new stacks, but take bonus magic damage from Braum's attacks.

Smolder.name: Super Scorcher Breath
Smolder.text: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

Smolder.name: Achooo!
Smolder.text: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.

Smolder.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
Smolder.text: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

Smolder.name: MMOOOMMMM!
Smolder.text: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.

Smolder.name: Dragon Practice
Smolder.text: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

Amumu.name: Bandage Toss
Amumu.text: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

Amumu.name: Despair
Amumu.text: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

Amumu.name: Tantrum
Amumu.text: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

Amumu.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
Amumu.text: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

Amumu.name: Cursed Touch
Amumu.text: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

Lulu.name: Glitterlance
Lulu.text: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.

Lulu.name: Whimsy
Lulu.text: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

Lulu.name: Help, Pix!
Lulu.text: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

Lulu.name: Wild Growth
Lulu.text: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

Lulu.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
Lulu.text: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.

Elise.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
Elise.text: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

Elise.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
Elise.text: Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.

Elise.name: Cocoon / Rappel
Elise.text: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

Elise.name: Spider Form
Elise.text: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

Elise.name: Spider Queen
Elise.text: Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

Aurora.name: Twofold Hex
Aurora.text: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.

Aurora.name: Across the Veil
Aurora.text: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.

Aurora.name: The Weirding
Aurora.text: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.

Aurora.name: Between Worlds
Aurora.text: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

Aurora.name: Spirit Abjuration
Aurora.text: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.

Bard.name: Cosmic Binding
Bard.text: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.

Bard.name: Caretaker's Shrine
Bard.text: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.

Bard.name: Magical Journey
Bard.text: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

Bard.name: Tempered Fate
Bard.text: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

Bard.name: Traveler's Call
Bard.text: Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough  Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit.Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.

Zed.name: Razor Shuriken
Zed.text: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

Zed.name: Living Shadow
Zed.text: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

Zed.name: Shadow Slash
Zed.text: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.

Zed.name: Death Mark
Zed.text: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

Zed.name: Contempt for the Weak
Zed.text: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.

Belveth.name: Void Surge
Belveth.text: Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through.

Belveth.name: Above and Below
Belveth.text: Bel'Veth slams her tail to the ground, damaging, knocking up, and slowing her enemies.

Belveth.name: Royal Maelstrom
Belveth.text: Bel'Veth roots herself in place, channeling a storm of slashes around her that targets the lowest-health enemy and grants her lifesteal and damage reduction.

Belveth.name: Endless Banquet
Belveth.text: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, and attack speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her the power to summon Void remora.

Belveth.name: Death in Lavender
Belveth.text: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions. She also gains temporary bonus attack speed after using an ability.

MasterYi.name: Alpha Strike
MasterYi.text: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

MasterYi.name: Meditate
MasterYi.text: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.

MasterYi.name: Wuju Style
MasterYi.text: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.

MasterYi.name: Highlander
MasterYi.text: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

MasterYi.name: Double Strike
MasterYi.text: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

Sett.name: Knuckle Down
Sett.text: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.

Sett.name: Haymaker
Sett.text: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

Sett.name: Facebreaker
Sett.text: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

Sett.name: The Show Stopper
Sett.text: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

Sett.name: Pit Grit
Sett.text: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.

Draven.name: Spinning Axe
Draven.text: Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage. This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.

Draven.name: Blood Rush
Draven.text: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed. The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration. Catching a Spinning Axe will refresh the cooldown of Blood Rush.

Draven.name: Stand Aside
Draven.text: Draven throws his axes, dealing physical damage to targets hit and knocking them aside. Targets hit are slowed.

Draven.name: Whirling Death
Draven.text: Draven hurls two massive axes to deal physical damage to each unit struck. Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and returns to Draven after striking an enemy champion. Draven may also activate this ability while the axes are in flight to cause it to return early. Deals less damage for each unit hit and resets when the axes reverse direction. Executes enemies who have less health than Draven's number of Adoration stacks.

Draven.name: League of Draven
Draven.text: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.

Lucian.name: Piercing Light
Lucian.text: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

Lucian.name: Ardent Blaze
Lucian.text: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

Lucian.name: Relentless Pursuit
Lucian.text: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

Lucian.name: The Culling
Lucian.text: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

Lucian.name: Lightslinger
Lucian.text: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

Yuumi.name: Prowling Projectile
Yuumi.text: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.

Yuumi.name: You and Me!
Yuumi.text: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.

Yuumi.name: Zoomies
Yuumi.text: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed. If she's attached, she passes it to her ally instead.

Yuumi.name: Final Chapter
Yuumi.text: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.

Yuumi.name: Feline Friendship
Yuumi.text: Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to.While Attached, Yuumi generates a special bond with her allies. The ally with the strongest bond enhances Yuumi's abilities while she is Attached to them.

Urgot.name: Corrosive Charge
Urgot.text: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

Urgot.name: Purge
Urgot.text: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

Urgot.name: Disdain
Urgot.text: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

Urgot.name: Fear Beyond Death
Urgot.text: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

Urgot.name: Echoing Flames
Urgot.text: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

Jade_Aatrox.name: Dark Flight
Jade_Aatrox.text: Aatrox takes flight and slams down at a targeted location, dealing damage and knocking up enemies at the center of impact.

Jade_Aatrox.name: Blood Thirst / Blood Price
Jade_Aatrox.text: While toggled on Aatrox deals bonus damage every third subsequent attack at the expense of his own Health. While toggled off Aatrox restores Health every third subsequent attack.

Jade_Aatrox.name: Blades of Torment
Jade_Aatrox.text: Aatrox unleashes the power of his blade, dealing damage to all enemies hit and slowing them.

Jade_Aatrox.name: Massacre
Jade_Aatrox.text: Aatrox draws in the blood of his foes, damaging all nearby enemy champions around him and gaining increased Attack Speed and bonus Attack Range for a short duration.

Jade_Aatrox.name: Blood Well
Jade_Aatrox.text: When using an ability that costs Health, Aatrox stores the self-inflicted damage into the Blood Well. Upon taking fatal damage Aatrox extracts the blood from the well and recovers it as health over a brief duration. Additionally, Aatrox gains 1% Attack Speed for every 2% blood that is in the well.

Zyra.name: Deadly Spines
Zyra.text: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. If cast near a seed, Deadly Spines grows a Thorn Spitter plant, which fires at enemies from afar.

Zyra.name: Rampant Growth
Zyra.text: Zyra plants a seed, lasting up to 60 seconds. Deadly Spines and Grasping Roots cast near seeds will turn them into plants who fight for Zyra. Zyra can store multiple seeds at once, and killing enemies reduces Rampant Growth's recharge time.

Zyra.name: Grasping Roots
Zyra.text: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing damage and rooting enemies they come across. If cast near a seed, Grasping Roots grows a Vine Lasher, whose short range attacks reduce enemy Move Speed.

Zyra.name: Stranglethorns
Zyra.text: Zyra summons a twisted thicket at her target location, dealing damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. Plants within the thicket are enraged.

Zyra.name: Garden of Thorns
Zyra.text: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level. Zyra can cast Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots near seeds to grow plants, who fight for Zyra.

Lux.name: Light Binding
Lux.text: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

Lux.name: Prismatic Barrier
Lux.text: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

Lux.name: Lucent Singularity
Lux.text: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

Lux.name: Final Spark
Lux.text: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

Lux.name: Illumination
Lux.text: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

Twitch.name: Ambush
Twitch.text: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

Twitch.name: Venom Cask
Twitch.text: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

Twitch.name: Contaminate
Twitch.text: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

Twitch.name: Spray and Pray
Twitch.text: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

Twitch.name: Deadly Venom
Twitch.text: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

Poppy.name: Hammer Shock
Poppy.text: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

Poppy.name: Steadfast Presence
Poppy.text: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

Poppy.name: Heroic Charge
Poppy.text: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

Poppy.name: Keeper's Verdict
Poppy.text: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

Poppy.name: Iron Ambassador
Poppy.text: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

Jade_JarvanIV.name: Dragon Strike
Jade_JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of all enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

Jade_JarvanIV.name: Golden Aegis
Jade_JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.

Jade_JarvanIV.name: Demacian Standard
Jade_JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed and Armor. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.

Jade_JarvanIV.name: Cataclysm
Jade_JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them.

Jade_JarvanIV.name: Martial Cadence
Jade_JarvanIV.text: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

Malzahar.name: Call of the Void
Malzahar.text: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

Malzahar.name: Void Swarm
Malzahar.text: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

Malzahar.name: Malefic Visions
Malzahar.text: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

Malzahar.name: Nether Grasp
Malzahar.text: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

Malzahar.name: Void Shift
Malzahar.text: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

Jade_Nasus.name: Siphoning Strike
Jade_Nasus.text: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

Jade_Nasus.name: Wither
Jade_Nasus.text: Nasus ages his target, decelerating their Movement and Attack Speeds over time.

Jade_Nasus.name: Spirit Fire
Jade_Nasus.text: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

Jade_Nasus.name: Fury of the Sands
Jade_Nasus.text: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, cast ranges, and drains nearby enemies' max Health converting into bonus damage for the duration.

Jade_Nasus.name: Soul Eater
Jade_Nasus.text: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Lifesteal.

Varus.name: Piercing Arrow
Varus.text: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

Varus.name: Blighted Quiver
Varus.text: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

Varus.name: Hail of Arrows
Varus.text: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

Varus.name: Chain of Corruption
Varus.text: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

Varus.name: Living Vengeance
Varus.text: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

Jade_Ahri.name: Orb of Deception
Jade_Ahri.text: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.

Jade_Ahri.name: Fox-Fire
Jade_Ahri.text: Ahri releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.

Jade_Ahri.name: Charm
Jade_Ahri.text: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and Charms the first enemy hit. They also take more damage from her for several seconds.

Jade_Ahri.name: Spirit Rush
Jade_Ahri.text: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging 3 nearby enemies (prioritizes Champions). Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown.

Jade_Ahri.name: Essence Theft
Jade_Ahri.text: Gains a charge of Essence Theft whenever a spell hits an enemy. Upon reaching maximum charges, the next spell restores Ahri's Health.

Hwei.name: Subject: Disaster
Hwei.text: Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow.This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.

Hwei.name: Subject: Serenity
Hwei.text: Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings.This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.

Hwei.name: Subject: Torment
Hwei.text: Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages.This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.

Hwei.name: Spiraling Despair
Hwei.text: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.

Hwei.name: Signature of the Visionary
Hwei.text: Hwei primes enemy champions he damages with his abilities for his signature finishing touch.Hitting an enemy with a second damaging spell completes his signature, leaving it beneath them. The signature detonates after a short delay, dealing magic damage to all enemies in range.

Nasus.name: Siphoning Strike
Nasus.text: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

Nasus.name: Wither
Nasus.text: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

Nasus.name: Spirit Fire
Nasus.text: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

Nasus.name: Fury of the Sands
Nasus.text: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

Nasus.name: Soul Eater
Nasus.text: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

Velkoz.name: Plasma Fission
Velkoz.text: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

Velkoz.name: Void Rift
Velkoz.text: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

Velkoz.name: Tectonic Disruption
Velkoz.text: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.

Velkoz.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
Velkoz.text: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

Velkoz.name: Organic Deconstruction
Velkoz.text: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

Taric.name: Starlight's Touch
Taric.text: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

Taric.name: Bastion
Taric.text: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

Taric.name: Dazzle
Taric.text: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

Taric.name: Cosmic Radiance
Taric.text: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

Taric.name: Bravado
Taric.text: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

Jade_Sion.name: Cryptic Gaze
Jade_Sion.text: Sion's stare terrifies a single enemy, dealing damage and stunning them.

Jade_Sion.name: Death's Caress
Jade_Sion.text: Sion surrounds himself with a damage-absorbing shield.  If the shield is not destroyed it will explode, damaging surrounding enemies. Sion can reactivate the ability to detonate the shield early.

Jade_Sion.name: Enrage
Jade_Sion.text: While active Sion gains Attack Damage at the cost of Health on each basic attack. Additonally, he permanently increases his maximum Health whenever he kills a unit.

Jade_Sion.name: Cannibalism
Jade_Sion.text: Sion consumes some of his enemies' life force on each attack, leeching health to himself and nearby allies. The smell of flesh also renews Sion's fervor, increasing his Attack Speed.

Jade_Sion.name: Feel No Pain
Jade_Sion.text: Sion has a chance to ignore some damage each time he is attacked.

Zoe.name: Paddle Star!
Zoe.text: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

Zoe.name: Spell Thief
Zoe.text: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

Zoe.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
Zoe.text: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

Zoe.name: Portal Jump
Zoe.text: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.

Zoe.name: More Sparkles!
Zoe.text: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

Jade_Fiddlesticks.name: Terrify
Jade_Fiddlesticks.text: Strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

Jade_Fiddlesticks.name: Drain
Jade_Fiddlesticks.text: Fiddlesticks saps the life force of an enemy, dealing damage to a target over time and healing himself.

Jade_Fiddlesticks.name: Dark Wind
Jade_Fiddlesticks.text: A wisp of wind strikes an enemy unit and then bounces to nearby enemy units, dealing damage and silencing the victims.

Jade_Fiddlesticks.name: Crowstorm
Jade_Fiddlesticks.text: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage each second to all enemy units in the area.

Jade_Fiddlesticks.name: Dread
Jade_Fiddlesticks.text: Nearby enemies have reduced Magic Resist.

Nilah.name: Formless Blade
Nilah.text: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.

Nilah.name: Jubilant Veil
Nilah.text: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.

Nilah.name: Slipstream
Nilah.text: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.

Nilah.name: Apotheosis
Nilah.text: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.

Nilah.name: Joy Unending
Nilah.text: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

Briar.name: Head Rush
Briar.text: Briar leaps to a unit and hits enemies with The Heel Wheel (of Pain), stunning them and breaking their Armor.

Briar.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
Briar.text: Briar leaps forward and shatters her pillory, entering a Blood Frenzy that causes her to relentlessly pursue the nearest enemy (prioritizing champions). While frenzied, she gains increased Attack Speed and Move Speed, and her attacks deal damage in an area around her target.Briar can reactivate this ability while frenzied to take a CHOMP out of her target on her next attack, dealing additional damage based on their missing Health, and healing Briar based on the damage she deals.

Briar.name: Chilling Scream
Briar.text: Briar refocuses her mind, removing Blood Frenzy and channeling energy into a powerful scream that damages and slows enemies. While charging, she takes reduced damage and heals for a portion of her max Health. A fully charged scream knocks foes back, dealing additional damage and stunning those who collide with a wall.

Briar.name: Certain Death
Briar.text: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone, marking the first champion it hits as her prey. She then beelines straight to them, fearing other surrounding enemies upon arriving at her target, and enters a state of complete hemomania. She will pursue her prey until death, gaining the benefits of Blood Frenzy as well as additional Armor, Magic Resistance, Life Steal, and Move Speed.

Briar.name: Crimson Curse
Briar.text: Briar's attacks and abilities apply a stacking bleed that heals her for a portion of the damage it deals. Perpetually hungry, she gains increased healing based on her missing Health, but lacks innate Health Regeneration.

Volibear.name: Thundering Smash
Volibear.text: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

Volibear.name: Frenzied Maul
Volibear.text: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them.  Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.

Volibear.name: Sky Splitter
Volibear.text: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

Volibear.name: Stormbringer
Volibear.text: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.  Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

Volibear.name: The Relentless Storm
Volibear.text: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

Rakan.name: Gleaming Quill
Rakan.text: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.

Rakan.name: Grand Entrance
Rakan.text: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.

Rakan.name: Battle Dance
Rakan.text: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.

Rakan.name: The Quickness
Rakan.text: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.

Ryze.name: Overload
Ryze.text: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

Ryze.name: Rune Prison
Ryze.text: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

Ryze.name: Spell Flux
Ryze.text: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.

Ryze.name: Realm Warp
Ryze.text: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux.On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

Ryze.name: Arcane Mastery
Ryze.text: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.

Hecarim.name: Rampage
Hecarim.text: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages.

Hecarim.name: Spirit of Dread
Hecarim.text: Hecarim gains Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and gains Health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.

Hecarim.name: Devastating Charge
Hecarim.text: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.

Hecarim.name: Onslaught of Shadows
Hecarim.text: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.

Hecarim.name: Warpath
Hecarim.text: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.

Shyvana.name: Emberstrike
Shyvana.text: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

Shyvana.name: Inferno Aegis
Shyvana.text: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

Shyvana.name: Molten Burst
Shyvana.text: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

Shyvana.name: Dragon's Descent
Shyvana.text: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

Shyvana.name: Scalemail
Shyvana.text: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

Rammus.name: Powerball
Rammus.text: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

Rammus.name: Defensive Ball Curl
Rammus.text: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

Rammus.name: Frenzying Taunt
Rammus.text: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

Rammus.name: Soaring Slam
Rammus.text: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

Rammus.name: Spiked Shell
Rammus.text: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

Blitzcrank.name: Rocket Grab
Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

Blitzcrank.name: Overdrive
Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank super charges themself to get dramatically increased Move and Attack Speed. They are temporarily slowed after the effect ends.

Blitzcrank.name: Power Fist
Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.

Blitzcrank.name: Static Field
Blitzcrank.text: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.

Blitzcrank.name: Mana Barrier
Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.

LeeSin.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
LeeSin.text: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

LeeSin.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
LeeSin.text: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

LeeSin.name: Tempest / Cripple
LeeSin.text: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

LeeSin.name: Dragon's Rage
LeeSin.text: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

LeeSin.name: Flurry
LeeSin.text: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

Karma.name: Inner Flame
Karma.text: Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

Karma.name: Focused Resolve
Karma.text: Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

Karma.name: Inspire
Karma.text: Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

Karma.name: Mantra
Karma.text: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

Karma.name: Gathering Fire
Karma.text: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

Kaisa.name: Icathian Rain
Kaisa.text: Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that seek out nearby targets.Living Weapon: Icathian Rain is upgraded to shoot more missiles.

Kaisa.name: Void Seeker
Kaisa.text: Kai'Sa shoots a long range missile, marking enemies with her passive.Living Weapon: Void Seeker is upgraded to apply more passive marks and reduce cooldown on champion hit.

Kaisa.name: Supercharge
Kaisa.text: Kai'Sa briefly increases her Move Speed, then increases her Attack Speed.Living Weapon: Supercharge is upgraded to briefly grant Invisibility.

Kaisa.name: Killer Instinct
Kaisa.text: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.

Kaisa.name: Second Skin
Kaisa.text: Kai'Sa's basic attacks stack Plasma, dealing increasing bonus magic damage. Allies' immobilizing effects help stack Plasma. Additionally, Kai'Sa's item purchases upgrade her basic spells to have more powerful properties.

Jade_Twitch.name: Ambush
Jade_Twitch.text: Twitch turns Invisible for several seconds, gaining Move Speed. He then gains Attack Speed after coming out of Invisibility.

Jade_Twitch.name: Venom Cask
Jade_Twitch.text: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes, inflicting Deadly Venom and slowing enemies in the area.

Jade_Twitch.name: Expunge
Jade_Twitch.text: All nearby enemies secrete Twitch's toxic venoms from their bodies, dealing damage for each stack.

Jade_Twitch.name: Spray and Pray
Jade_Twitch.text: Twitch closes his eyes and fires his crossbow, rapidly spraying powerful piercing bolts ahead of him.

Jade_Twitch.name: Deadly Venom
Jade_Twitch.text: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target, dealing magic damage each second.

Garen.name: Decisive Strike
Garen.text: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

Garen.name: Courage
Garen.text: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.

Garen.name: Judgment
Garen.text: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

Garen.name: Demacian Justice
Garen.text: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

Garen.name: Perseverance
Garen.text: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

Vayne.name: Tumble
Vayne.text: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

Vayne.name: Silver Bolts
Vayne.text: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

Vayne.name: Condemn
Vayne.text: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

Vayne.name: Final Hour
Vayne.text: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

Vayne.name: Night Hunter
Vayne.text: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

Renata.name: Handshake
Renata.text: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

Renata.name: Bailout
Renata.text: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

Renata.name: Loyalty Program
Renata.text: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.

Renata.name: Hostile Takeover
Renata.text: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

Renata.name: Leverage
Renata.text: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

Jade_Nunu.name: Consume
Jade_Nunu.text: Nunu commands the yeti to take a bite out of a target minion or monster, dealing heavy damage to it and healing himself.

Jade_Nunu.name: Blood Boil
Jade_Nunu.text: Nunu invigorates himself and an allied unit by heating their blood, increasing their Movement and Attack Speeds.

Jade_Nunu.name: Ice Blast
Jade_Nunu.text: Nunu launches a ball of ice at an enemy unit, dealing damage and temporarily slowing their Movement and Attack Speeds.

Jade_Nunu.name: Absolute Zero
Jade_Nunu.text: Nunu begins to sap the area of heat, slowing all nearby enemies. When the spell ends, he deals massive damage to all enemies caught in the area.

Jade_Nunu.name: Visionary
Jade_Nunu.text: Nunu can cast a spell for free after several attacks.

Jade_Akali.name: Mark of the Assassin
Jade_Akali.text: Akali spins her kama at a target enemy to deal magic damage and mark the target. Akali's next melee attack against a marked target will consume the mark to cause additional damage and restore Energy.

Jade_Akali.name: Twilight Shroud
Jade_Akali.text: Akali throws down a cover of smoke. While inside the area, Akali gains Armor and Magic Resist and becomes invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her. Enemies inside the smoke have their Movement Speed reduced.

Jade_Akali.name: Crescent Slash
Jade_Akali.text: Akali flourishes her kamas, dealing damage based on her Attack Damage and Ability Power.

Jade_Akali.name: Shadow Dance
Jade_Akali.text: Akali moves through shadows to quickly strike her target, dealing damage and consuming an Essence of Shadow charge. Akali recharges Essence of Shadow charges both periodically and upon kills and assists, max 3 stacks.

Jade_Akali.name: Twin Disciplines
Jade_Akali.text: Gain damage on hit based on ability powerGain spell vamp based on attack damage

Jade_Sona.name: Hymn of Valor
Jade_Sona.text: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, granting nearby allied champions bonus Damage and Ability Power. Additionally, casting this ability sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to the nearest two enemy champions or monsters.

Jade_Sona.name: Aria of Perseverance
Jade_Sona.text: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, granting nearby allied champions bonus Armor and Magic Resist. Additionally, casting this ability sends out healing melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally.

Jade_Sona.name: Song of Celerity
Jade_Sona.text: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Movement Speed. Additionally, casting this ability energizes nearby allies with a burst of speed.

Jade_Sona.name: Crescendo
Jade_Sona.text: Sona plays her ultimate chord, forcing enemy champions to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

Jade_Sona.name: Power Chord
Jade_Sona.text: Every few spells, Sona's next attack deals bonus magic damage and causes her target to deal reduced damage for a few seconds.

Tryndamere.name: Bloodlust
Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

Tryndamere.name: Mocking Shout
Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

Tryndamere.name: Spinning Slash
Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

Tryndamere.name: Undying Rage
Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

Tryndamere.name: Battle Fury
Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

Jade_KogMaw.name: Caustic Spittle
Jade_KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile that damages his target and corrodes their Armor and Magic Resist.

Jade_KogMaw.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
Jade_KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage.

Jade_KogMaw.name: Void Ooze
Jade_KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

Jade_KogMaw.name: Living Artillery
Jade_KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw fires a living artillery shell at a great distance dealing damage and revealing targets.  Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional mana.

Jade_KogMaw.name: Icathian Surprise
Jade_KogMaw.text: Upon dying, Kog'Maw starts a chain reaction in his body which causes him to detonate after a few seconds, damaging surrounding enemies.

Morgana.name: Dark Binding
Morgana.text: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

Morgana.name: Tormented Shadow
Morgana.text: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.

Morgana.name: Black Shield
Morgana.text: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

Morgana.name: Soul Shackles
Morgana.text: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

Morgana.name: Soul Siphon
Morgana.text: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

Skarner.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
Skarner.text: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

Skarner.name: Seismic Bastion
Skarner.text: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

Skarner.name: Ixtal's Impact
Skarner.text: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

Skarner.name: Impale
Skarner.text: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

Skarner.name: Threads of Vibration
Skarner.text: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

Thresh.name: Death Sentence
Thresh.text: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

Thresh.name: Dark Passage
Thresh.text: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

Thresh.name: Flay
Thresh.text: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

Thresh.name: The Box
Thresh.text: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.

Thresh.name: Damnation
Thresh.text: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

Jade_Tristana.name: Rapid Fire
Jade_Tristana.text: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her attack speed for a short time.

Jade_Tristana.name: Rocket Jump
Jade_Tristana.text: Tristana fires at the ground to propel herself to a distant location, damaging and slowing enemies where she lands.

Jade_Tristana.name: Explosive Shot
Jade_Tristana.text: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies.  Can be activated to deal damage to target unit over time, and reduce healing received.

Jade_Tristana.name: Buster Shot
Jade_Tristana.text: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals magic damage and knocks the target back.

Jade_Tristana.name: Draw a Bead
Jade_Tristana.text: Increases Tristana's attack range as she levels.

Ekko.name: Timewinder
Ekko.text: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that expands into a time-distortion field upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing and damaging anyone caught inside. After a delay, the grenade rewinds back to Ekko, dealing damage on its return.

Ekko.name: Parallel Convergence
Ekko.text: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.

Ekko.name: Phase Dive
Ekko.text: Ekko rolls evasively while charging up his Z-Drive. His next attack deals bonus damage and warps reality, teleporting him to his target.

Ekko.name: Chronobreak
Ekko.text: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.

Ekko.name: Z-Drive Resonance
Ekko.text: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.

Jade_Fizz.name: Urchin Strike
Jade_Fizz.text: Fizz strikes his target and runs them through, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

Jade_Fizz.name: Seastone Trident
Jade_Fizz.text: Fizz's Trident causes rending wounds in his opponents, dealing magic damage to the target based on their missing health.

Jade_Fizz.name: Playful / Trickster
Jade_Fizz.text: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

Jade_Fizz.name: Chum the Waters
Jade_Fizz.text: Fizz unleashes a magical fish that latches onto enemies or hovers over terrain, slowing champions if it is latched on to them. After a brief delay, a shark erupts from beneath the earth, dealing damage to enemies around the fish and knocking them aside.

Jade_Fizz.name: Nimble Fighter
Jade_Fizz.text: Fizz's dexterity allows him to move through units and take less physical damage from basic attacks.

Jade_Ryze.name: Overload
Jade_Ryze.text: Passive: Ryze permanently gains Cooldown Reduction.Active: Ryze unleashes an orb of energy, dealing magic damage to his target.

Jade_Ryze.name: Rune Prison
Jade_Ryze.text: Ryze magically imprisons an enemy, rooting them and dealing magic damage.

Jade_Ryze.name: Spell Flux
Jade_Ryze.text: Ryze fires a chaotic bolt of magic that can bounce between enemies, dealing magic damage and reducing their Magic Resist.

Jade_Ryze.name: Desperate Power
Jade_Ryze.text: Ryze temporary harnesses his full powers, gaining area of effect damage on all abilities, Spell Vamp, and Move Speed for a short time.

Jade_Ryze.name: Arcane Mastery
Jade_Ryze.text: Ryze's abilities reduce the cooldown of all other abilities.

Jade_Yorick.name: Omen of War
Jade_Yorick.text: Yorick's next attack will deal bonus damage and summon a Spectral Ghoul that deals additional damage and moves faster than Yorick's other ghouls. While the Spectral Ghoul is alive, Yorick moves faster as well.

Jade_Yorick.name: Omen of Pestilence
Jade_Yorick.text: Yorick summons a Decaying Ghoul that arrives with a violent explosion, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. The Decaying Ghoul slows nearby enemies.

Jade_Yorick.name: Omen of Famine
Jade_Yorick.text: Yorick steals life from his target and summons a Ravenous Ghoul that heals Yorick for the damage it deals.

Jade_Yorick.name: Omen of Death
Jade_Yorick.text: Yorick conjures a revenant in the image of one of his allies. If his ally dies while its revenant is alive, the revenant sacrifices itself to reanimate them and give them time to enact vengeance.

Jade_Yorick.name: Unholy Covenant
Jade_Yorick.text: Yorick's takes reduced damage and his basic attacks deal more damage for each summon that is active. Meanwhile, Yorick's ghouls scale off Yorick's Attack Damage and Health.

Darius.name: Decimate
Darius.text: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.

Darius.name: Crippling Strike
Darius.text: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

Darius.name: Apprehend
Darius.text: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

Darius.name: Noxian Guillotine
Darius.text: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.

Darius.name: Hemorrhage
Darius.text: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

Talon.name: Noxian Diplomacy
Talon.text: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

Talon.name: Rake
Talon.text: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

Talon.name: Assassin's Path
Talon.text: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

Talon.name: Shadow Assault
Talon.text: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

Talon.name: Blade's End
Talon.text: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

Aatrox.name: The Darkin Blade
Aatrox.text: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect.

Aatrox.name: Infernal Chains
Aatrox.text: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.

Aatrox.name: Umbral Dash
Aatrox.text: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.

Aatrox.name: World Ender
Aatrox.text: Aatrox unleashes his demonic form, fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.

Aatrox.name: Deathbringer Stance
Aatrox.text: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him, based on the target's max health.

Leblanc.name: Sigil of Malice
Leblanc.text: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

Leblanc.name: Distortion
Leblanc.text: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

Leblanc.name: Ethereal Chains
Leblanc.text: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

Leblanc.name: Mimic
Leblanc.text: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

Leblanc.name: Mirror Image
Leblanc.text: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

Riven.name: Broken Wings
Riven.text: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

Riven.name: Ki Burst
Riven.text: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

Riven.name: Valor
Riven.text: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

Riven.name: Blade of the Exile
Riven.text: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

Riven.name: Runic Blade
Riven.text: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

Alistar.name: Pulverize
Alistar.text: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.

Alistar.name: Headbutt
Alistar.text: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

Alistar.name: Trample
Alistar.text: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.

Alistar.name: Unbreakable Will
Alistar.text: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

Alistar.name: Triumphant Roar
Alistar.text: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.

Ahri.name: Orb of Deception
Ahri.text: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.

Ahri.name: Fox-Fire
Ahri.text: Ahri gains a brief burst of Move Speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.

Ahri.name: Charm
Ahri.text: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.

Ahri.name: Spirit Rush
Ahri.text: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown, and gains additional recasts when taking down enemy champions.

Ahri.name: Essence Theft
Ahri.text: After killing 9 minions or monsters, Ahri heals.After taking down an enemy champion, Ahri heals for a greater amount.

Mel.name: Radiant Volley
Mel.text: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

Mel.name: Rebuttal
Mel.text: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

Mel.name: Solar Snare
