Mel.text: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

Mel.name: Golden Eclipse
Mel.text: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

Mel.name: Searing Brilliance
Mel.text: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack.When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

Annie.name: Disintegrate
Annie.text: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

Annie.name: Incinerate
Annie.text: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

Annie.name: Molten Shield
Annie.text: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

Annie.name: Summon: Tibbers
Annie.text: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

Annie.name: Pyromania
Annie.text: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

Jade_LeeSin.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
Jade_LeeSin.text: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, damaging the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike.Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing more damage plus a portion of their missing health.

Jade_LeeSin.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
Jade_LeeSin.text: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes towards a target ally, shielding them both from damage. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle, gaining Life Steal, Spell Vamp, and Armor.

Jade_LeeSin.name: Tempest / Cripple
Jade_LeeSin.text: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple for the next 3 seconds.Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies revealed by Tempest, reducing their Movement and Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Movement and Attack Speed recover gradually over the duration.

Jade_LeeSin.name: Dragon's Rage
Jade_LeeSin.text: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

Jade_LeeSin.name: Flurry
Jade_LeeSin.text: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

Vi.name: Vault Breaker
Vi.text: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

Vi.name: Denting Blows
Vi.text: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.

Vi.name: Relentless Force
Vi.text: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

Vi.name: Cease and Desist
Vi.text: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

Vi.name: Blast Shield
Vi.text: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

KSante.name: Ntofo Strikes
KSante.text: K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.When All Out, cooldown is reduced.

KSante.name: Path Maker
KSante.text: K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.

KSante.name: Footwork
KSante.text: K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield.When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.

KSante.name: All Out
KSante.text: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.

KSante.name: Dauntless Instinct
KSante.text: K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack.When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.

Jade_Mordekaiser.name: Mace of Spades
Jade_Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser's next attack emits with such force that it echoes out, striking up to 3 additional nearby targets, dealing damage plus bonus damage. If the target is alone, the attack deals extra damage.

Jade_Mordekaiser.name: Creeping Death
Jade_Mordekaiser.text: Unleashes a protective cloud of metal shards to surround an ally, increasing their armor and magic resistance and dealing damage per second to enemies in the cloud.

Jade_Mordekaiser.name: Siphon of Destruction
Jade_Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser deals damage to enemies in a cone in front of him.

Jade_Mordekaiser.name: Children of the Grave
Jade_Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser curses an enemy, stealing a percent of their life initially and each second. If the target dies while the spell is active, their soul is enslaved and will follow Mordekaiser as a ghost for 30 seconds.

Jade_Mordekaiser.name: Iron Man
Jade_Mordekaiser.text: A percent of the damage dealt from abilities is converted into a temporary shield, absorbing incoming damage.

Jade_Kassadin.name: Null Sphere
Jade_Kassadin.text: Kassadin fires an ethereal bolt of void energy, dealing damage and silencing the target for a duration.

Jade_Kassadin.name: Nether Blade
Jade_Kassadin.text: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks restore Mana. Active: Kassadin's basic attacks deal additional magic damage.

Jade_Kassadin.name: Force Pulse
Jade_Kassadin.text: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

Jade_Kassadin.name: Riftwalk
Jade_Kassadin.text: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Additionally, multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana and deal additional damage.

Jade_Kassadin.name: Void Stone
Jade_Kassadin.text: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and transforms incoming magic damage into bonus Attack Speed.

Jade_Wukong.name: Crushing Blow
Jade_Wukong.text: Wukong's next attack gains extra range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the enemy's Armor.

Jade_Wukong.name: Decoy
Jade_Wukong.text: Wukong becomes invisible and spawns an uncontrollable decoy that will damage nearby enemies after a short delay.

Jade_Wukong.name: Nimbus Strike
Jade_Wukong.text: Wukong dashes toward a target enemy and sends out images to attack up to 2 additional enemies near his target, dealing physical damage to each enemy struck.

Jade_Wukong.name: Cyclone
Jade_Wukong.text: Wukong's staff grows outward and he spins it around, dealing damage and knocking up enemies. Wukong gains movement speed over the duration of the spell.

Jade_Wukong.name: Stone Skin
Jade_Wukong.text: Increases Wukong's armor and magic resistance for each nearby enemy champion.

Jade_Olaf.name: Undertow
Jade_Olaf.text: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to units it passes through and slowing their movement speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced.

Jade_Olaf.name: Vicious Strikes
Jade_Olaf.text: Olaf's attack damage is increased, based on his health, and he gains massive lifesteal and spell vamp.

Jade_Olaf.name: Reckless Swing
Jade_Olaf.text: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself.

Jade_Olaf.name: Ragnarok
Jade_Olaf.text: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to disables and gains bonus Armor, Magic Resist, and Lethality.

Jade_Olaf.name: Berserker Rage
Jade_Olaf.text: Olaf's Attack Speed increases as his Health decreases.

Jayce.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
Jayce.text: Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.

Jayce.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
Jayce.text: Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds.Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.

Jayce.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
Jayce.text: Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

Jayce.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
Jayce.text: Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.

Jayce.name: Hextech Capacitor
Jayce.text: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed for a short duration.

Kassadin.name: Null Sphere
Kassadin.text: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.

Kassadin.name: Nether Blade
Kassadin.text: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.

Kassadin.name: Force Pulse
Kassadin.text: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

Kassadin.name: Riftwalk
Kassadin.text: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.

Kassadin.name: Void Stone
Kassadin.text: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.

Jade_Amumu.name: Bandage Toss
Jade_Amumu.text: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

Jade_Amumu.name: Despair
Jade_Amumu.text: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum health each second.

Jade_Amumu.name: Tantrum
Jade_Amumu.text: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

Jade_Amumu.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
Jade_Amumu.text: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

Jade_Amumu.name: Cursed Touch
Jade_Amumu.text: Amumu's attacks reduce his target's Magic Resist.

Sona.name: Hymn of Valor
Sona.text: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

Sona.name: Aria of Perseverance
Sona.text: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

Sona.name: Song of Celerity
Sona.text: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

Sona.name: Crescendo
Sona.text: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

Sona.name: Power Chord
Sona.text: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

Jade_Gragas.name: Barrel Roll
Jade_Gragas.text: Gragas rolls a barrel that explodes after a short delay, damaging and slowing Attack Speed. Recast to detonate the barrel early.

Jade_Gragas.name: Drunken Rage
Jade_Gragas.text: Gragas guzzles down brew from his cask, restoring Mana. He then gains Attack Damage and reduces damage taken for several seconds.

Jade_Gragas.name: Body Slam
Jade_Gragas.text: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, damaging nearby enemies and Slowing them.

Jade_Gragas.name: Explosive Cask
Jade_Gragas.text: Gragas hurls his cask, damaging and Knocking Away enemies from the impact.

Jade_Gragas.name: Happy Hour
Jade_Gragas.text: On ability use, Gragas takes a drink, restoring some of his Health.

Caitlyn.name: Piltover Peacemaker
Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

Caitlyn.name: Yordle Snap Trap
Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

Caitlyn.name: 90 Caliber Net
Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

Caitlyn.name: Ace in the Hole
Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

Caitlyn.name: Headshot
Caitlyn.text: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

Jade_Shen.name: Vorpal Blade
Jade_Shen.text: Damages target unit and life taps him, healing allies that attack the target.

Jade_Shen.name: Feint
Jade_Shen.text: Shen shields himself, absorbing incoming damage for a few seconds.

Jade_Shen.name: Shadow Dash
Jade_Shen.text: Shen dashes rapidly toward a target location, taunting enemy champions he encounters and dealing minor damage.

Jade_Shen.name: Stand United
Jade_Shen.text: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

Jade_Shen.name: Ki Strike
Jade_Shen.text: Periodically, Shen's next attack deals bonus damage. Each time Shen attacks a minion, monster, or champion, Ki Strike's cooldown is reduced.

Yone.name: Mortal Steel
Yone.text: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.

Yone.name: Spirit Cleave
Yone.text: Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe.Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.

Yone.name: Soul Unbound
Yone.text: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.

Yone.name: Fate Sealed
Yone.text: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.

Yone.name: Way of the Hunter
Yone.text: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.

Jade_Katarina.name: Bouncing Blade
Jade_Katarina.text: Katarina throws a dagger that bounces from enemy to enemy, dealing magic damage.

Jade_Katarina.name: Sinister Steel
Jade_Katarina.text: Katarina whirls her daggers around her, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area. If she hits an enemy Champion, Katarina gains a burst of speed for a short duration.

Jade_Katarina.name: Shunpo
Jade_Katarina.text: Katarina instantly moves to her target's location and takes reduced damage from enemies for a few seconds. If the target is an enemy, she deals damage.

Jade_Katarina.name: Death Lotus
Jade_Katarina.text: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, throwing daggers with unrivaled speed at nearby enemy Champions, dealing significant damage and applying Wounds.

Corki.name: Phosphorus Bomb
Corki.text: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.

Corki.name: Valkyrie
Corki.text: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.

Corki.name: Gatling Gun
Corki.text: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

Corki.name: Missile Barrage
Corki.text: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

Corki.name: Hextech Munitions
Corki.text: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.

Ornn.name: Volcanic Rupture
Ornn.text: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.

Ornn.name: Bellows Breath
Ornn.text: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

Ornn.name: Searing Charge
Ornn.text: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

Ornn.name: Call of the Forge God
Ornn.text: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

Ornn.name: Living Forge
Ornn.text: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources.Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere.Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.

Sivir.name: Boomerang Blade
Sivir.text: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

Sivir.name: Ricochet
Sivir.text: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

Sivir.name: Spell Shield
Sivir.text: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

Sivir.name: On The Hunt
Sivir.text: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

Sivir.name: Fleet of Foot
Sivir.text: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

Jade_Anivia.name: Flash Frost
Jade_Anivia.text: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

Jade_Anivia.name: Crystallize
Jade_Anivia.text: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

Jade_Anivia.name: Frostbite
Jade_Anivia.text: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing a medium amount of damage. If the target has been slowed by an ice effect, the damage they take is doubled.

Jade_Anivia.name: Glacial Storm
Jade_Anivia.text: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

Jade_Anivia.name: Rebirth
Jade_Anivia.text: Upon dying, Anivia will revert into an egg. If the egg can survive, she is gloriously reborn.

Jade_XinZhao.name: Three Talon Strike
Jade_XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage that reduce his other ability cooldowns, with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

Jade_XinZhao.name: Battle Cry
Jade_XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao passively heals every 3 attacks and can activate this ability to attack faster.

Jade_XinZhao.name: Audacious Charge
Jade_XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.

Jade_XinZhao.name: Crescent Sweep
Jade_XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back. Xin Zhao gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist based on number of champions hit.

Jade_XinZhao.name: Challenge
Jade_XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao challenges his target with his basic attacks and Audacious Charge, reducing their armor.

Jade_Pantheon.name: Spear Shot
Jade_Pantheon.text: Pantheon hurls his spear at an opponent, dealing damage.

Jade_Pantheon.name: Aegis of Zeonia
Jade_Pantheon.text: Pantheon leaps at an enemy and bashes the enemy with his shield, stunning them. After finishing the attack, Pantheon readies himself to block the next attack.

Jade_Pantheon.name: Heartseeker Strike
Jade_Pantheon.text: Pantheon focuses and unleashes swift strikes to the area in front of him, dealing increased damage to champions. Pantheon also becomes more aware of his enemy's vital spots, allowing him to critically strike against wounded enemies.

Jade_Pantheon.name: Grand Skyfall
Jade_Pantheon.text: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air to a target, striking all enemy units in an area. Enemies closer to the impact point take more damage.

Jade_Pantheon.name: Aegis Protection
Jade_Pantheon.text: After every 4 attacks or spell casts, Pantheon gains protection from the next attack.

Jade_Annie.name: Disintegrate
Jade_Annie.text: Annie hurls a mana-infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the mana cost if it destroys the target.

Jade_Annie.name: Incinerate
Jade_Annie.text: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

Jade_Annie.name: Molten Shield
Jade_Annie.text: Increases Annie's Armor and Magic Resist and damages enemies who hit Annie with basic attacks.

Jade_Annie.name: Summon: Tibbers
Jade_Annie.text: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

Jade_Annie.name: Pyromania
Jade_Annie.text: Annie's offensive spells occasionally Stuns her target(s).

Jade_Rammus.name: Powerball
Jade_Rammus.text: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

Jade_Rammus.name: Defensive Ball Curl
Jade_Rammus.text: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his armor and magic resistance, while returning damage to attacks.

Jade_Rammus.name: Puncturing Taunt
Jade_Rammus.text: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against Rammus' hard shell, reducing Armor temporarily.

Jade_Rammus.name: Tremors
Jade_Rammus.text: Rammus creates waves of destruction pulsing through the ground, causing damage to units and structures near him.

Jade_Rammus.name: Spiked Shell
Jade_Rammus.text: Rammus gains additional damage as his shell becomes reinforced, converting a portion of his Armor into Attack Damage.

FiddleSticks.name: Terrify
FiddleSticks.text: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

FiddleSticks.name: Bountiful Harvest
FiddleSticks.text: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.

FiddleSticks.name: Reap
FiddleSticks.text: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.

FiddleSticks.name: Crowstorm
FiddleSticks.text: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.

FiddleSticks.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
FiddleSticks.text: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.

Taliyah.name: Threaded Volley
Taliyah.text: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.

Taliyah.name: Seismic Shove
Taliyah.text: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

Taliyah.name: Unraveled Earth
Taliyah.text: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

Taliyah.name: Weaver's Wall
Taliyah.text: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

Taliyah.name: Rock Surfing
Taliyah.text: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

Warwick.name: Jaws of the Beast
Warwick.text: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

Warwick.name: Blood Hunt
Warwick.text: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

Warwick.name: Primal Howl
Warwick.text: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

Warwick.name: Infinite Duress
Warwick.text: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

Warwick.name: Eternal Hunger
Warwick.text: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

Jade_DrMundo.name: Infected Cleaver
Jade_DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo hurls his cleaver, dealing damage based on his victims maximum health.

Jade_DrMundo.name: Burning Agony
Jade_DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo drains his health to reduce the duration of disables and deal continual damage to nearby enemies.

Jade_DrMundo.name: Masochism
Jade_DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo's gains Attack Damage for a few seconds based on his missing health.

Jade_DrMundo.name: Sadism
Jade_DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo sacrifices a portion of his Health for increased Movement Speed and drastically increased Health Regeneration.

Jade_DrMundo.name: Adrenaline Rush
Jade_DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo regenerates a portion of his maximum Health each second.

Jade_Brand.name: Sear
Jade_Brand.text: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

Jade_Brand.name: Pillar of Flame
Jade_Brand.text: After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units with the area. Units that are ablaze take additional damage

Jade_Brand.name: Conflagration
Jade_Brand.text: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing magic damage to them. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies.

Jade_Brand.name: Pyroclasm
Jade_Brand.text: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire, dealing magic damage each time it bounces. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will priotize champions for the next bounce.

Jade_Brand.name: Blaze
Jade_Brand.text: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing a portion of their maximum Health in magic damage.

Pantheon.name: Comet Spear
Pantheon.text: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

Pantheon.name: Shield Vault
Pantheon.text: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

Pantheon.name: Aegis Assault
Pantheon.text: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

Pantheon.name: Grand Starfall
Pantheon.text: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

Pantheon.name: Mortal Will
Pantheon.text: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

Naafiri.name: Darkin Daggers
Naafiri.text: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding.Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.

Naafiri.name: The Call of the Pack
Naafiri.text: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

Naafiri.name: Eviscerate
Naafiri.text: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.

Naafiri.name: Hounds' Pursuit
Naafiri.text: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.

Naafiri.name: We Are More
Naafiri.text: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

Irelia.name: Bladesurge
Irelia.text: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

Irelia.name: Defiant Dance
Irelia.text: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

Irelia.name: Flawless Duet
Irelia.text: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.

Irelia.name: Vanguard's Edge
Irelia.text: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.

Irelia.name: Ionian Fervor
Irelia.text: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

Diana.name: Crescent Strike
Diana.text: Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.

Diana.name: Pale Cascade
Diana.text: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

Diana.name: Lunar Rush
Diana.text: Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

Diana.name: Moonfall
Diana.text: Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

Diana.name: Moonsilver Blade
Diana.text: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

Jade_Irelia.name: Bladesurge
Jade_Irelia.text: Irelia dashes to strike her target. If it kills, Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes and refunds some of its Mana cost.

Jade_Irelia.name: Hiten Style
Jade_Irelia.text: Passive: Irelia's attacks restore Health.Active: Irelia's attacks deal bonus true damage and restore more Health for a few seconds.

Jade_Irelia.name: Equilibrium Strike
Jade_Irelia.text: Irelia's attack balances the scales, dealing damage and slowing her target. If they have a higher Health % than her, the blow stuns them instead.

Jade_Irelia.name: Transcendent Blades
Jade_Irelia.text: Irelia summons 4 spirit blades that she can fling to damage and siphon life from enemies they pass through.

Jade_Irelia.name: Ionian Fervor
Jade_Irelia.text: Irelia gains Tenacity for each nearby enemy champion.

Brand.name: Sear
Brand.text: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

Brand.name: Pillar of Flame
Brand.text: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.

Brand.name: Conflagration
Brand.text: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.

Brand.name: Pyroclasm
Brand.text: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.

Brand.name: Blaze
Brand.text: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

Seraphine.name: High Note
Seraphine.text: Seraphine deals damage in an area.

Seraphine.name: Surround Sound
Seraphine.text: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.

Seraphine.name: Beat Drop
Seraphine.text: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.

Seraphine.name: Encore
Seraphine.text: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.

Seraphine.name: Stage Presence
Seraphine.text: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

Graves.name: End of the Line
Graves.text: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain.

Graves.name: Smoke Screen
Graves.text: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.

Graves.name: Quickdraw
Graves.text: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.

Graves.name: Collateral Damage
Graves.text: Graves fires an explosive shell dealing heavy damage to the first champion it hits. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.

Graves.name: New Destiny
Graves.text: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

Viego.name: Blade of the Ruined King
Viego.text: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

Viego.name: Spectral Maw
Viego.text: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

Viego.name: Harrowed Path
Viego.text: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

Viego.name: Heartbreaker
Viego.text: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

Viego.name: Sovereign's Domination
Viego.text: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

Locke.name: Ritual Nails
Locke.text: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

Locke.name: Soul Ignition
Locke.text: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.

Locke.name: Ashen Pursuit
Locke.text: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

Locke.name: Purgatory
Locke.text: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.

Locke.name: Silver Stake
Locke.text: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

Jinx.name: Switcheroo!
Jinx.text: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.

Jinx.name: Zap!
Jinx.text: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.

Jinx.name: Flame Chompers!
Jinx.text: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.

Jinx.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
Jinx.text: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

Jinx.name: Get Excited!
Jinx.text: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.

Evelynn.name: Hate Spike
Evelynn.text: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.

Evelynn.name: Allure
Evelynn.text: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.

Evelynn.name: Whiplash
Evelynn.text: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.

Evelynn.name: Last Caress
Evelynn.text: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

Evelynn.name: Demon Shade
Evelynn.text: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

Orianna.name: Command: Attack
Orianna.text: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

Orianna.name: Command: Dissonance
Orianna.text: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

Orianna.name: Command: Protect
Orianna.text: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

Orianna.name: Command: Shockwave
Orianna.text: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

Orianna.name: Clockwork Windup
Orianna.text: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

Jade_Vayne.name: Tumble
Jade_Vayne.text: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot.  Her next attack deals bonus damage.

Jade_Vayne.name: Silver Bolts
Jade_Vayne.text: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things.  The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's maximum Health as bonus true damage.

Jade_Vayne.name: Condemn
Jade_Vayne.text: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, dealing damage and knocking them back.  If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

Jade_Vayne.name: Final Hour
Jade_Vayne.text: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, invisibility during Tumble, and greatly increased bonus Movement Speed from Night Hunter.

Jade_Vayne.name: Night Hunter
Jade_Vayne.text: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers. She gains bonus Movement Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

Sylas.name: Chain Lash
Sylas.text: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

Sylas.name: Kingslayer
Sylas.text: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

Sylas.name: Abscond / Abduct
Sylas.text: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

Sylas.name: Hijack
Sylas.text: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

Sylas.name: Petricite Burst
Sylas.text: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

Akali.name: Five Point Strike
Akali.text: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.

Akali.name: Twilight Shroud
Akali.text: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

Akali.name: Shuriken Flip
Akali.text: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.

Akali.name: Perfect Execution
Akali.text: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.

Akali.name: Assassin's Mark
Akali.text: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.

Jade_Lux.name: Light Binding
Jade_Lux.text: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

Jade_Lux.name: Prismatic Barrier
Jade_Lux.text: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

Jade_Lux.name: Lucent Singularity
Jade_Lux.text: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

Jade_Lux.name: Finales Funkeln
Jade_Lux.text: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area.  In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

Jade_Lux.name: Illumination
Jade_Lux.text: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage.

Jade_Karthus.name: Lay Waste
Jade_Karthus.text: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Jade_Karthus.name: Wall of Pain
Jade_Karthus.text: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy.  Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Movement Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.

Jade_Karthus.name: Defile
Jade_Karthus.text: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill.  Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own mana.

Jade_Karthus.name: Requiem
Jade_Karthus.text: After channeling, Karthus damages all enemy champions.

Jade_Karthus.name: Death Defied
Jade_Karthus.text: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form allowing him to continue casting spells while dead for a short time.

JarvanIV.name: Dragon Strike
JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

JarvanIV.name: Golden Aegis
JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.

JarvanIV.name: Demacian Standard
JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.

JarvanIV.name: Cataclysm
JarvanIV.text: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.

JarvanIV.name: Martial Cadence
JarvanIV.text: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

Ivern.name: Rootcaller
Ivern.text: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.

Ivern.name: Brushmaker
Ivern.text: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.

Ivern.name: Triggerseed
Ivern.text: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.

Ivern.name: Daisy!
Ivern.text: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.

Ivern.name: Friend of the Forest
Ivern.text: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.

Xerath.name: Arcanopulse
Xerath.text: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

Xerath.name: Eye of Destruction
Xerath.text: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

Xerath.name: Shocking Orb
Xerath.text: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

Xerath.name: Rite of the Arcane
Xerath.text: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

Xerath.name: Mana Surge
Xerath.text: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

Fizz.name: Urchin Strike
Fizz.text: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

Fizz.name: Seastone Trident
Fizz.text: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.

Fizz.name: Playful / Trickster
Fizz.text: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

Fizz.name: Chum the Waters
Fizz.text: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

Fizz.name: Nimble Fighter
Fizz.text: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources

Lissandra.name: Ice Shard
Lissandra.text: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.

Lissandra.name: Ring of Frost
Lissandra.text: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.

Lissandra.name: Glacial Path
Lissandra.text: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.

Lissandra.name: Frozen Tomb
Lissandra.text: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.

Lissandra.name: Iceborn Subjugation
Lissandra.text: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

KogMaw.name: Caustic Spittle
KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.

KogMaw.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

KogMaw.name: Void Ooze
KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

KogMaw.name: Living Artillery
KogMaw.text: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.

KogMaw.name: Icathian Surprise
KogMaw.text: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

Viktor.name: Siphon Power
Viktor.text: Viktor blasts an enemy unit with magic damage, which grants him a shield and empowers his next basic attack.Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus move speed after casting the Ability.

Viktor.name: Gravity Field
Viktor.text: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies caught within its radius. Enemies who stay in the field for too long become stunned.Augment: Viktor's spells apply a slow to enemies.

Viktor.name: Hextech Ray
Viktor.text: Viktor uses his biomechanical arm to fire a Hextech Ray that cuts across the field in a line, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.Augment: An explosion follows in the Hextech Ray's wake, dealing magic damage.

Viktor.name: Arcane Storm
Viktor.text: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm on the field, dealing magic damage and interrupting enemy channels. The storm periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies and can be redirected by Viktor.Augment: The Arcane Storm moves 25% faster, and whenever champions die after taking damage from it, the storm grows and increases in its duration.

Viktor.name: Glorious Evolution
Viktor.text: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability. After upgrading all of his basic abilities, he can gather 100 Hex Fragments to augment his ultimate ability.

Janna.name: Howling Gale
Janna.text: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

Janna.name: Zephyr
Janna.text: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.

Janna.name: Eye Of The Storm
Janna.text: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

Janna.name: Monsoon
Janna.text: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

Janna.name: Tailwind
Janna.text: Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

Qiyana.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
Qiyana.text: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

Qiyana.name: Terrashape
Qiyana.text: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

Qiyana.name: Audacity
Qiyana.text: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.

Qiyana.name: Supreme Display of Talent
Qiyana.text: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

Qiyana.name: Royal Privilege
Qiyana.text: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.

Azir.name: Conquering Sands
Azir.text: Azir sends all Sand Soldiers towards a location. Sand Soldiers deal magic damage to enemies they pass through and apply a slow for 1 second.

Azir.name: Arise!
Azir.text: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.

Azir.name: Shifting Sands
Azir.text: Azir shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, damaging enemies. If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier for deployment and halts his dash.

Azir.name: Emperor's Divide
Azir.text: Azir summons a wall of soldiers which charge forward, knocking back and damaging enemies.

Azir.name: Shurima's Legacy
Azir.text: Azir can summon the Disc of the Sun from the ruins of allied or enemy turrets.

Jade_MissFortune.name: Double Up
Jade_MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them.

Jade_MissFortune.name: Impure Shots
Jade_MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune passively increases damage dealt to a target with each strike.  This ability can be activated to increase Miss Fortune's Attack Speed and cause her attacks to lower healing received by the target.

Jade_MissFortune.name: Make It Rain
Jade_MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune unleashes a flurry of bullets at a location, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

Jade_MissFortune.name: Bullet Time
Jade_MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune channels a flurry of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies.

Jade_MissFortune.name: Strut
Jade_MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune has increased Movement Speed until she is hit in combat.

Sion.name: Decimating Smash
Sion.text: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

Sion.name: Soul Furnace
Sion.text: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

Sion.name: Roar of the Slayer
Sion.text: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

Sion.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
Sion.text: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

Sion.name: Glory in Death
Sion.text: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

Renekton.name: Cull the Meek
Renekton.text: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

Renekton.name: Ruthless Predator
Renekton.text: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

Renekton.name: Slice and Dice
Renekton.text: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

Renekton.name: Dominus
Renekton.text: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

Renekton.name: Reign of Anger
Renekton.text: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

Veigar.name: Baleful Strike
Veigar.text: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

Veigar.name: Dark Matter
Veigar.text: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

Veigar.name: Event Horizon
Veigar.text: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

Veigar.name: Primordial Burst
Veigar.text: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

Veigar.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
Veigar.text: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

RekSai.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
RekSai.text: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.

RekSai.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
RekSai.text: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

RekSai.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
RekSai.text: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

RekSai.name: Void Rush
RekSai.text: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.

RekSai.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
RekSai.text: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

Jade_Nidalee.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
Jade_Nidalee.text: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

Jade_Nidalee.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
Jade_Nidalee.text: In human form, Nidalee lays a damaging trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages, reveals, reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. As a cougar, she pounces forward, dealing a small amount of damage when she lands.

Jade_Nidalee.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
Jade_Nidalee.text: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with attack speed for a short duration.  As a cougar, she rapidly claws enemies in front of her.

Jade_Nidalee.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
Jade_Nidalee.text: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities and increased Movement Speed.

Jade_Nidalee.name: Prowl
Jade_Nidalee.text: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Movement Speed.

Jade_Corki.name: Phosphorus Bomb
Jade_Corki.text: Corki fires a bomb, damaging and revealing enemies around the blast.

Jade_Corki.name: Valkyrie
Jade_Corki.text: Corki surges to target location, dropping bombs that create a trail of destruction for opponents who remain in the fire.

Jade_Corki.name: Gatling Gun
Jade_Corki.text: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy armor.

Jade_Corki.name: Missile Barrage
Jade_Corki.text: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Some missiles will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

Jade_Corki.name: Hextech Shrapnel Shells
Jade_Corki.text: Corki's basic attacks deal bonus true damage to minions, monsters, and champions.

Kayn.name: Reaping Slash
Kayn.text: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.

Kayn.name: Blade's Reach
Kayn.text: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.

Kayn.name: Umbral Trespass
Kayn.text: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.

Kayn.name: The Darkin Scythe
Kayn.text: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin.Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions.Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

TwistedFate.name: Wild Cards
TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

TwistedFate.name: Pick a Card
TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

TwistedFate.name: Stacked Deck
TwistedFate.text: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

TwistedFate.name: Destiny
TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

TwistedFate.name: Loaded Dice
TwistedFate.text: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

Pyke.name: Bone Skewer
Pyke.text: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.

Pyke.name: Ghostwater Dive
Pyke.text: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.

Pyke.name: Phantom Undertow
Pyke.text: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.

Pyke.name: Death From Below
Pyke.text: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

Pyke.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
Pyke.text: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.

Jade_Shyvana.name: Twin Bite
Jade_Shyvana.text: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite. Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front Shyvana.

Jade_Shyvana.name: Burnout
Jade_Shyvana.text: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and briefly moving faster. The movement speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout scorches the ground beneath it, enemies on the scorched earth continue to take damage.

Jade_Shyvana.name: Flame Breath
Jade_Shyvana.text: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target briefly marking them. Basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum health as damage on-hit. Dragon Form: Flame Breath engulfs all units in a cone in front of her.

Jade_Shyvana.name: Dragon's Descent
Jade_Shyvana.text: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location. Shyvana passively gains Armor and Magic Resistance. Defensive bonuses are doubled in Dragon Form.

Jade_Shyvana.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
Jade_Shyvana.text: Shyvana's basic attacks enhance her abilities.

Udyr.name: Wilding Claw
Udyr.text: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

Udyr.name: Iron Mantle
Udyr.text: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

Udyr.name: Blazing Stampede
Udyr.text: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

Udyr.name: Wingborne Storm
Udyr.text: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.

Udyr.name: Bridge Between
Udyr.text: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

Ashe.name: Ranger's Focus
Ashe.text: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration.

Ashe.name: Volley
Ashe.text: Ashe fires arrows in a cone for increased damage. Also applies Frost Shot.

Ashe.name: Hawkshot
Ashe.text: Ashe sends her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission anywhere on the map.

Ashe.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
Ashe.text: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

Ashe.name: Frost Shot
Ashe.text: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets.Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

Trundle.name: Chomp
Trundle.text: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

Trundle.name: Frozen Domain
Trundle.text: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

Trundle.name: Pillar of Ice
Trundle.text: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

Trundle.name: Subjugate
Trundle.text: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

Trundle.name: King's Tribute
Trundle.text: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

Nami.name: Aqua Prison
Nami.text: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

Nami.name: Ebb and Flow
Nami.text: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.

Nami.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
Nami.text: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

Nami.name: Tidal Wave
Nami.text: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

Nami.name: Surging Tides
Nami.text: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

Jade_Evelynn.name: Hate Spike
Jade_Evelynn.text: Evelynn fires a line of spikes through an enemy, dealing damage to all enemies in its path.

Jade_Evelynn.name: Dark Frenzy
Jade_Evelynn.text: Evelynn passively increases her Movement Speed when hitting enemy champions with her spells. Upon activation, Evelynn breaks free from slows affecting her and gains a massive Movement Speed boost for a short duration.

Jade_Evelynn.name: Ravage
Jade_Evelynn.text: Evelynn slashes her target twice, dealing damage with each hit. She then gains increased Attack Speed for a short duration.

Jade_Evelynn.name: Agony's Embrace
Jade_Evelynn.text: Evelynn summons spikes from the ground to deal damage and slow enemies in the area. She then gains a shield based on how many enemy champions were hit.

Jade_Evelynn.name: Shadow Walk
Jade_Evelynn.text: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Camoflauge only being able to be seen by nearby enemy champions or true sight. While stealthed, she rapidly regenerates Mana.

Zeri.name: Burst Fire
Zeri.text: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

Zeri.name: Ultrashock Laser
Zeri.text: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit. If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.

Zeri.name: Spark Surge
Zeri.text: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.

Zeri.name: Lightning Crash
Zeri.text: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.

Zeri.name: Living Battery
Zeri.text: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.

Jade_Poppy.name: Devastating Blow
Jade_Poppy.text: Poppy's next attack crushes her opponent, dealing bonus damage based on her target's max health.

Jade_Poppy.name: Paragon of Demacia
Jade_Poppy.text: Passive: Upon receiving damage from or dealing damage with a basic attack, Poppy's armor and damage are increased, which can stack. Active: Poppy gains max stacks of Paragon of Demacia increased movement speed.

Jade_Poppy.name: Heroic Charge
Jade_Poppy.text: Poppy charges at an enemy and carries them further. The initial impact deals a small amount of damage, and if they collide with terrain, her target will take a high amount of damage and be stunned.

Jade_Poppy.name: Diplomatic Immunity
Jade_Poppy.text: Poppy focuses intently on a single enemy champion, dealing increased damage to them. Poppy is immune to any damage and abilities from enemies other than her target.

Jade_Poppy.name: Valiant Fighter
Jade_Poppy.text: Damage dealt to Poppy that exceeds a portion of her current health is reduced.

Cassiopeia.name: Noxious Blast
Cassiopeia.text: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.

Cassiopeia.name: Miasma
Cassiopeia.text: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.

Cassiopeia.name: Twin Fang
Cassiopeia.text: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.

Cassiopeia.name: Petrifying Gaze
Cassiopeia.text: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.

Cassiopeia.name: Serpentine Grace
Cassiopeia.text: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.

Kennen.name: Thundering Shuriken
Kennen.text: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.

Kennen.name: Electrical Surge
Kennen.text: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

Kennen.name: Lightning Rush
Kennen.text: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.

Kennen.name: Slicing Maelstrom
Kennen.text: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

Kennen.name: Mark of the Storm
Kennen.text: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

Gragas.name: Barrel Roll
Gragas.text: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed.

Gragas.name: Drunken Rage
Gragas.text: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

Gragas.name: Body Slam
Gragas.text: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

Gragas.name: Explosive Cask
Gragas.text: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

Gragas.name: Happy Hour
Gragas.text: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.

Tristana.name: Rapid Fire
Tristana.text: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

Tristana.name: Rocket Jump
Tristana.text: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

Tristana.name: Explosive Charge
Tristana.text: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

Tristana.name: Buster Shot
Tristana.text: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

Tristana.name: Draw a Bead
Tristana.text: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

XinZhao.name: Three Talon Strike
XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

XinZhao.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.

XinZhao.name: Audacious Charge
XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.

XinZhao.name: Crescent Guard
XinZhao.text: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

XinZhao.name: Determination
XinZhao.text: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

Ambessa.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
Ambessa.text: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

Ambessa.name: Repudiation
Ambessa.text: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.

Ambessa.name: Lacerate
Ambessa.text: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

Ambessa.name: Public Execution
Ambessa.text: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

Ambessa.name: Drakehound's Step
Ambessa.text: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

Fiora.name: Lunge
Fiora.text: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

Fiora.name: Riposte
