Fiora.text: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

Fiora.name: Bladework
Fiora.text: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.

Fiora.name: Grand Challenge
Fiora.text: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

Fiora.name: Duelist's Dance
Fiora.text: Fiora has revealed a Vital on this Champion. If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.

Aphelios.name: Weapon Abilites
Aphelios.text: Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

Aphelios.name: Phase
Aphelios.text: Aphelios swaps his main-hand gun with his off-hand gun, replacing his basic attack and activated ability.

Aphelios.name: Weapon Queue System
Aphelios.text: Aphelios has no third ability. This slot shows the next weapon Alune will give him. Weapon order begins fixed but may change over game time -- when a weapon is out of ammo it goes to the end of the order.

Aphelios.name: Moonlight Vigil
Aphelios.text: Fire a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes on enemy champions. Applies the unique effect of Aphelios' main-hand gun.

Aphelios.name: The Hitman and the Seer
Aphelios.text: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.

Lillia.name: Blooming Blows
Lillia.text: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

Lillia.name: Watch Out! Eep!
Lillia.text: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.

Lillia.name: Swirlseed
Lillia.text: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

Lillia.name: Lilting Lullaby
Lillia.text: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

Lillia.name: Dream-Laden Bough
Lillia.text: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

Jade_Malzahar.name: Call of the Void
Jade_Malzahar.text: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

Jade_Malzahar.name: Null Zone
Jade_Malzahar.text: Malzahar creates a zone of negative energy that damages nearby enemies each second.

Jade_Malzahar.name: Malefic Visions
Jade_Malzahar.text: Malzahar infects his target's mind, dealing damage over time. If the target dies during this time, the visions pass to a nearby enemy and Malzahar gains mana.

Jade_Malzahar.name: Nether Grasp
Jade_Malzahar.text: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress target champion while dealing magic damage over time.

Jade_Malzahar.name: Summon Voidling
Jade_Malzahar.text: Every few spells, Malzahar summons an uncontrollable Voidling to engage his enemies. Voidlings grow over time, gaining armor, damage, and attack speed.

Jade_Tryndamere.name: Bloodlust
Jade_Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, gaining Fury that increasing his Attack and Critical Strike Damage as he kills enemies and deals critical strikes. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

Jade_Tryndamere.name: Mocking Shout
Jade_Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere mocks nearby champions for their cowardice, reducing their Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Movement Speed reduced.

Jade_Tryndamere.name: Spinning Slash
Jade_Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

Jade_Tryndamere.name: Undying Rage
Jade_Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

Jade_Tryndamere.name: Battle Fury
Jade_Tryndamere.text: Tryndamere gains bonus critical strike chance, increased by his missing Health.

Zilean.name: Time Bomb
Zilean.text: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.

Zilean.name: Rewind
Zilean.text: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.

Zilean.name: Time Warp
Zilean.text: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.

Zilean.name: Chronoshift
Zilean.text: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

Zilean.name: Time In A Bottle
Zilean.text: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

AurelionSol.name: Breath of Light
AurelionSol.text: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath for a few seconds, damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion.

AurelionSol.name: Astral Flight
AurelionSol.text: Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction. While in this state, he can cast other abilities. Breath of Light no longer has a cooldown or maximum channel duration and deals increased damage while flying.Astral Flight's remaining cooldown is reduced whenever an enemy champion dies after being recently damaged by Aurelion Sol.Stardust increases Astral Flight's maximum range.

AurelionSol.name: Singularity
AurelionSol.text: Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, damaging enemies and slowly pulling them toward its center. This ability grants Stardust each time an enemy dies within the black hole and for each second an enemy champion is caught inside it. The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain percentage of their maximum health. Stardust increases Singularity's area as well as the execution threshold.

AurelionSol.name: Falling Star / The Skies Descend
AurelionSol.text: Falling Star: Aurelion Sol crashes a star into the earth. This impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies while also granting Stardust for each enemy champion it hits. Gathering enough Stardust transforms Aurelion Sol's next Falling Star into The Skies Descend.The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol drags a giant star down from the heavens with an increased impact zone and increased damage, knocking up enemies rather than stunning them. A shockwave then spreads from the edge of the impact zone, which damages and slows the enemies it hits. Stardust increases the impact area of both Falling Star and The Skies Descend.

AurelionSol.name: Cosmic Creator
AurelionSol.text: Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into stacks of Stardust, which permanently improves each of his abilities.

Jax.name: Leap Strike
Jax.text: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

Jax.name: Empower
Jax.text: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

Jax.name: Counter Strike
Jax.text: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

Jax.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
Jax.text: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

Jax.name: Relentless Assault
Jax.text: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

Jade_Shaco.name: Deceive
Jade_Shaco.text: Shaco becomes invisible and teleports to target location. His next attack is guaranteed to critically strike.

Jade_Shaco.name: Jack In The Box
Jade_Shaco.text: Shaco creates an animated Jack-in-the-Box at target location, which will wait, invisible, to Fear nearby units and attack them when some come nearby.

Jade_Shaco.name: Two-Shiv Poison
Jade_Shaco.text: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing them and applying a miss chance to minions. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target.

Jade_Shaco.name: Hallucinate
Jade_Shaco.text: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies. Upon death, it explodes, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Jade_Shaco.name: Backstab
Jade_Shaco.text: Shaco's Attacks and abilities deal bonus damage from behind.

Nunu.name: Consume
Nunu.text: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

Nunu.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
Nunu.text: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it.  The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

Nunu.name: Snowball Barrage
Nunu.text: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies.  When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

Nunu.name: Absolute Zero
Nunu.text: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

Nunu.name: Call of the Freljord
Nunu.text: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

Singed.name: Poison Trail
Singed.text: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

Singed.name: Mega Adhesive
Singed.text: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

Singed.name: Fling
Singed.text: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

Singed.name: Insanity Potion
Singed.text: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

Singed.name: Noxious Slipstream
Singed.text: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

Akshan.name: Avengerang
Akshan.text: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.

Akshan.name: Going Rogue
Akshan.text: Akshan passively marks enemy champions as Scoundrels when they kill his ally champions. If Akshan kills a Scoundrel, he resurrects the allies they killed, gains bonus gold, and clears all marks.When activated, Akshan enters camouflage and gains Move Speed and Mana Regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.

Akshan.name: Heroic Swing
Akshan.text: Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging. He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.

Akshan.name: Comeuppance
Akshan.text: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and starts storing bullets. When released, he fires all stored bullets, dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.

Akshan.name: Dirty Fighting
Akshan.text: Every three hits from Akshan's Attacks and Abilities deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion.When Akshan Attacks, he fires an additional Attack for reduced damage. If he cancels the additional Attack, he instead gains Move Speed.

Chogath.name: Rupture
Chogath.text: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

Chogath.name: Feral Scream
Chogath.text: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

Chogath.name: Vorpal Spikes
Chogath.text: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.

Chogath.name: Feast
Chogath.text: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.

Chogath.name: Carnivore
Chogath.text: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

Jade_Malphite.name: Seismic Shard
Jade_Malphite.text: Using his primal elemental magic, Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing their movement speed.

Jade_Malphite.name: Brutal Strikes
Jade_Malphite.text: Malphite starts to hit with such force that his attacks deal damage to all units in front of him. Activating Brutal Strikes greatly increases his Armor and Attack Damage for a short amount of time.

Jade_Malphite.name: Ground Slam
Jade_Malphite.text: Malphite slams the ground sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor as damage and reduces the Attack speed of enemies for a short duration.

Jade_Malphite.name: Unstoppable Force
Jade_Malphite.text: Malphite ferociously charges to a location, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

Jade_Malphite.name: Granite Shield
Jade_Malphite.text: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage. If Malphite has not been hit recently, this effect recharges.

Jade_Ezreal.name: Mystic Shot
Jade_Ezreal.text: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

Jade_Ezreal.name: Essence Flux
Jade_Ezreal.text: Ezreal fires a fluctuating wave of energy, decreasing the Attack Speed and dealing magic damage to enemy champions, while healing and increasing the Attack Speed of allied champions.

Jade_Ezreal.name: Arcane Shift
Jade_Ezreal.text: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit.

Jade_Ezreal.name: Trueshot Barrage
Jade_Ezreal.text: Ezreal fires a powerful barrage of energy missiles which do massive damage to each unit it passes through.

Jade_Ezreal.name: Rising Spell Force
Jade_Ezreal.text: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell.

Jade_Galio.name: Resolute Smite
Jade_Galio.text: Galio fires a concussive blast from his eyes, slowing and dealing damage to enemies caught near the impact point.

Jade_Galio.name: Bulwark
Jade_Galio.text: Galio shields an ally Champion, increasing their Armor and Magic Resistance, and restoring Galio's health each time that Champion suffers damage.

Jade_Galio.name: Righteous Gust
Jade_Galio.text: Galio claps his wings, unleashing a gust of concussive wind that damages enemies and leaves a directional draft in its wake that increases ally movement speed.

Jade_Galio.name: Idol of Durand
Jade_Galio.text: Galio assumes the form of a statue, taunting nearby enemies and storing concussive energy as they attack him.  Galio then bursts from his statue shell, releasing the stored energy to damage surrounding foes.

Jade_Galio.name: Runic Skin
Jade_Galio.text: Galio converts Magic Resistance into Ability Power.

Jade_Jax.name: Empower
Jade_Jax.text: Jax's next attack or Leap Strike deals bonus damage and damages nearby enemies.

Jade_Jax.name: Counter Strike
Jade_Jax.text: Jax enters a defensive stance, dodging all incoming basic attacks and taking less damage from area of effect abilities. Then he stuns surrounding enemies and damages them.

Jade_Jax.name: Relentless Assault
Jade_Jax.text: Jax gains attack speed when he strikes. Every third consecutive attack deals bonus damage.

Jade_Jax.name: Equipment Mastery
Jade_Jax.text: Jax's gains bonus Health based on his bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power from items.

Ezreal.name: Mystic Shot
Ezreal.text: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

Ezreal.name: Essence Flux
Ezreal.text: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

Ezreal.name: Arcane Shift
Ezreal.text: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

Ezreal.name: Trueshot Barrage
Ezreal.text: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

Ezreal.name: Rising Spell Force
Ezreal.text: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

Jade_TwistedFate.name: Wild Cards
Jade_TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

Jade_TwistedFate.name: Pick A Card
Jade_TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

Jade_TwistedFate.name: Gate
Jade_TwistedFate.text: After channeling, Twisted Fate Teleports to any target location.

Jade_TwistedFate.name: Destiny
Jade_TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing and slowing all enemy champions. Gate's channel time is also reduced during this duration.

Jade_TwistedFate.name: Loaded Dice
Jade_TwistedFate.text: Twisted Fate and his allies receive an additional gold per kill.

Jade_Ashe.name: Frost Shot
Jade_Ashe.text: While active, each of Ashe's basic attacks slow her targets. This drains Mana with each attack.

Jade_Ashe.name: Volley
Jade_Ashe.text: Ashe fires 7 arrows in a cone for increased damage.  Volley also applies Ashe's current level of Frost Shot.

Jade_Ashe.name: Hawkshot
Jade_Ashe.text: Each time Ashe kills a unit, she gains some extra gold. Ashe can activate to send her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission.

Jade_Ashe.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
Jade_Ashe.text: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line.  If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion for up to 3.5 seconds, based on how far the arrow has traveled.  In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

Jade_Ashe.name: Focus
Jade_Ashe.text: Ashe gains stacks of Focus while out-of-combat. When Ashe has 100 stacks of Focus, her next basic Attack will critically strike.

Rell.name: Shattering Strike
Rell.text: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

Rell.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
Rell.text: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

Rell.name: Full Tilt
Rell.text: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed.Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.

Rell.name: Magnet Storm
Rell.text: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

Rell.name: Break the Mold
Rell.text: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

Gangplank.name: Parrrley
Gangplank.text: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed.

Gangplank.name: Remove Scurvy
Gangplank.text: Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.

Gangplank.name: Powder Keg
Gangplank.text: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.

Gangplank.name: Cannon Barrage
Gangplank.text: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.

Gangplank.name: Trial by Fire
Gangplank.text: Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.

Jade_Alistar.name: Pulverize
Jade_Alistar.text: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to all nearby enemies and tossing them into the air. On landing, enemies are stunned.

Jade_Alistar.name: Headbutt
Jade_Alistar.text: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

Jade_Alistar.name: Triumphant Roar
Jade_Alistar.text: Alistar lets out a commanding war cry, restoring health to himself and nearby allies. Nearby enemy deaths reduce the cooldown.

Jade_Alistar.name: Unbreakable Will
Jade_Alistar.text: Alistar lets out a wild roar, gaining bonus damage, removing all crowd-control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

Jade_Alistar.name: Trample
Jade_Alistar.text: Each time Alistar casts a spell, he Tramples nearby units and turrets for a few seconds, dealing damage to units he walks over.

Zac.name: Stretching Strikes
Zac.text: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

Zac.name: Unstable Matter
Zac.text: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.

Zac.name: Elastic Slingshot
Zac.text: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

Zac.name: Let's Bounce!
Zac.text: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.

Zac.name: Cell Division
Zac.text: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.

Jade_Hecarim.name: Rampage
Jade_Hecarim.text: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage.

Jade_Hecarim.name: Spirit of Dread
Jade_Hecarim.text: Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies for a short duration. Hecarim gains health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.

Jade_Hecarim.name: Devastating Charge
Jade_Hecarim.text: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.

Jade_Hecarim.name: Onslaught of Shadows
Jade_Hecarim.text: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.

Jade_Hecarim.name: Warpath
Jade_Hecarim.text: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.

Jade_Morgana.name: Dark Binding
Jade_Morgana.text: Morgana releases a sphere of dark magic.  Upon contact with an enemy unit, the sphere will deal magic damage and force the unit to the ground for a period of time.

Jade_Morgana.name: Tormented Soil
Jade_Morgana.text: Infects an area with desecrated soil, causing enemy units who stand on the location to take continual damage.

Jade_Morgana.name: Black Shield
Jade_Morgana.text: Places a protective barrier around an allied champion, absorbing magical damage and disables until penetrated or the shield dissipates.

Jade_Morgana.name: Soul Shackles
Jade_Morgana.text: Latches chains of energy onto nearby enemy champions, dealing initial damage to them and slowing their Movement Speed, and then echoing the pain a few seconds later and stunning them if they remain close to Morgana.

Jade_Morgana.name: Soul Siphon
Jade_Morgana.text: Morgana has Spell Vamp, healing herself whenever she deals damage with her spells.

Neeko.name: Blooming Burst
Neeko.text: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.

Neeko.name: Shapesplitter
Neeko.text: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.

Neeko.name: Tangle-Barbs
Neeko.text: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.

Neeko.name: Pop Blossom
Neeko.text: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.

Neeko.name: Inherent Glamour
Neeko.text: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.

Swain.name: Death's Hand
Swain.text: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

Swain.name: Vision of Empire
Swain.text: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

Swain.name: Nevermove
Swain.text: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

Swain.name: Demonic Ascension
Swain.text: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

Swain.name: Ravenous Flock
Swain.text: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

Heimerdinger.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

Heimerdinger.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.

Heimerdinger.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.

Heimerdinger.name: UPGRADE!!!
Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.

Heimerdinger.name: Hextech Affinity
Heimerdinger.text: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.

Malphite.name: Seismic Shard
Malphite.text: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

Malphite.name: Thunderclap
Malphite.text: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

Malphite.name: Ground Slam
Malphite.text: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

Malphite.name: Unstoppable Force
Malphite.text: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

Malphite.name: Granite Shield
Malphite.text: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

Jade_Karma.name: Heavenly Wave
Jade_Karma.text: Karma sends forth hidden blades from her fans, damaging enemies in a cone.Mantra: Heavenly Wave also heals allies in the cone based on their missing Health.

Jade_Karma.name: Spirit Bond
Jade_Karma.text: Karma creates a beam between her and another unit. Allied anchors move faster and enemy anchors are slowed. The beam damages enemies and applies the same movement speed adjustment to any champion it passes through.Mantra: Karma strengthens the bond to increase the movement speed effect.

Jade_Karma.name: Soul Shield
Jade_Karma.text: Karma summons a protective shield on an ally that absorbs incoming damage.Mantra: In addition to casting the shield, energy radiates out from the shield, damaging enemies around her target.

Jade_Karma.name: Mantra
Jade_Karma.text: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

Jade_Karma.name: Inner Flame
Jade_Karma.text: Karma gains Ability Power based on her missing Health.

Jade_Heimerdinger.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
Jade_Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger lays down a machine gun turret. Turrets gain abilities as this skill is increased. (Turrets deal half damage to towers).

Jade_Heimerdinger.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
Jade_Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that hit the enemies closest to Heimerdinger.

Jade_Heimerdinger.name: CH-1 Concussion Grenade
Jade_Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units as well as stunning anyone directly hit and blinding surrounding units.

Jade_Heimerdinger.name: UPGRADE!!!
Jade_Heimerdinger.text: Passive / Active: Passively increases Cooldown Reduction.  Activate to heal all active Evolution Turrets and cause them to fire frost shots, which reduce Movement Speed, for a short time.

Jade_Heimerdinger.name: Techmaturgical Repair Bots
Jade_Heimerdinger.text: Heimerdinger gives nearby allied Turrets and Champions increased Health Regeneration.

Jade_Nami.name: Aqua Prison
Jade_Nami.text: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

Jade_Nami.name: Ebb and Flow
Jade_Nami.text: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies, healing allies and damaging enemies.

Jade_Nami.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
Jade_Nami.text: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.

Jade_Nami.name: Tidal Wave
Jade_Nami.text: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies.

Jade_Nami.name: Surging Tides
Jade_Nami.text: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

Yorick.name: Last Rites
Yorick.text: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

Yorick.name: Dark Procession
Yorick.text: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

Yorick.name: Mourning Mist
Yorick.text: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

Yorick.name: Eulogy of the Isles
Yorick.text: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

Yorick.name: Shepherd of Souls
Yorick.text: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

Milio.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
Milio.text: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

Milio.name: Cozy Campfire
Milio.text: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

Milio.name: Warm Hugs
Milio.text: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

Milio.name: Breath of Life
Milio.text: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

Milio.name: Fired Up!
Milio.text: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

Teemo.name: Blinding Dart
Teemo.text: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

Teemo.name: Move Quick
Teemo.text: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

Teemo.name: Toxic Shot
Teemo.text: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

Teemo.name: Noxious Trap
Teemo.text: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

Teemo.name: Guerrilla Warfare
Teemo.text: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

MonkeyKing.name: Crushing Blow
MonkeyKing.text: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

MonkeyKing.name: Warrior Trickster
MonkeyKing.text: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

MonkeyKing.name: Nimbus Strike
MonkeyKing.text: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

MonkeyKing.name: Cyclone
MonkeyKing.text: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

MonkeyKing.name: Stone Skin
MonkeyKing.text: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

Jade_Taric.name: Imbue
Jade_Taric.text: Taric brings forth earthen energy to heal an ally and himself. This heal is more potent when Taric heals only himself. Additionally,Taric's basic attacks reduce Imbue's cooldown.

Jade_Taric.name: Shatter
Jade_Taric.text: Taric is protected by a hardening aura, increasing the Armor of himself and nearby allied champions. He may choose to splinter the enchanted rocks surrounding him to deal damage and decrease the Armor of nearby enemies at the cost of some Armor for a short time.

Jade_Taric.name: Dazzle
Jade_Taric.text: Taric emits a brilliant ball of prismatic light from his gemmed shield, stunning his target and damaging them based on how close he is to them.

Jade_Taric.name: Radiance
Jade_Taric.text: Taric slams his hammer into the ground to deal damage to nearby enemies. For a time after, Taric's gems radiate energy empowering Taric and his allies with bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power

Jade_Taric.name: Gemcraft
Jade_Taric.text: Taric loves to socket magical gems into all of his weapons, resulting in his basic attacks dealing bonus magic damage based on his maximum Mana.

Shaco.name: Deceive
Shaco.text: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

Shaco.name: Jack In The Box
Shaco.text: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.

Shaco.name: Two-Shiv Poison
Shaco.text: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.

Shaco.name: Hallucinate
Shaco.text: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets).  Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Shaco.name: Backstab
Shaco.text: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.

Zaahen.name: The Darkin Glaive
Zaahen.text: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.

Zaahen.name: Dreaded Return
Zaahen.text: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

Zaahen.name: Aureate Rush
Zaahen.text: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.

Zaahen.name: Grim Deliverance
Zaahen.text: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

Zaahen.name: Cultivation of War
Zaahen.text: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions  grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

Jade_Veigar.name: Baleful Strike
Jade_Veigar.text: Unleashes dark energy at target enemy, dealing magic damage. If a unit is killed, Veigar gains some Ability Power permanently.

Jade_Veigar.name: Dark Matter
Jade_Veigar.text: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands.

Jade_Veigar.name: Event Horizon
Jade_Veigar.text: Veigar twists the edges of space around the target location for 3 seconds, stunning enemies who pass through the perimeter for a short duration.

Jade_Veigar.name: Primordial Burst
Jade_Veigar.text: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large base amount of magic damage plus 80% of his target's AP.

Jade_Veigar.name: Equilibrium
Jade_Veigar.text: Veigar's mana regeneration increases based on his missing mana.

MissFortune.name: Double Up
MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

MissFortune.name: Strut
MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

MissFortune.name: Make It Rain
MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

MissFortune.name: Bullet Time
MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

MissFortune.name: Love Tap
MissFortune.text: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

Ziggs.name: Bouncing Bomb
Ziggs.text: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

Ziggs.name: Satchel Charge
Ziggs.text: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

Ziggs.name: Hexplosive Minefield
Ziggs.text: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

Ziggs.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
Ziggs.text: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.

Ziggs.name: Short Fuse
Ziggs.text: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

Nidalee.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
Nidalee.text: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

Nidalee.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
Nidalee.text: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.

Nidalee.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
Nidalee.text: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.

Nidalee.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
Nidalee.text: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.

Nidalee.name: Prowl
Nidalee.text: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range.Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

Kayle.name: Radiant Blast
Kayle.text: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

Kayle.name: Celestial Blessing
Kayle.text: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.

Kayle.name: Starfire Spellblade
Kayle.text: Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks.Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.

Kayle.name: Divine Judgment
Kayle.text: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.

Kayle.name: Divine Ascent
Kayle.text: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

Kled.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
Kled.text: Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled.When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.

Kled.name: Violent Tendencies
Kled.text: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.

Kled.name: Jousting
Kled.text: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.

Kled.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
Kled.text: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.

Kled.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
Kled.text: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

Jade_Garen.name: Decisive Strike
Jade_Garen.text: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

Jade_Garen.name: Courage
Jade_Garen.text: Garen performs a dance of death with his sword, dealing damage around him for the duration.

Jade_Garen.name: Judgment
Jade_Garen.text: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

Jade_Garen.name: Demacian Justice
Jade_Garen.text: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

Jade_Garen.name: Perseverance
Jade_Garen.text: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

Galio.name: Winds of War
Galio.text: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.

Galio.name: Shield of Durand
Galio.text: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.

Galio.name: Justice Punch
Galio.text: Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.

Galio.name: Hero's Entrance
Galio.text: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.

Galio.name: Colossal Smash
Galio.text: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.

Soraka.name: Starcall
Soraka.text: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

Soraka.name: Astral Infusion
Soraka.text: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

Soraka.name: Equinox
Soraka.text: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

Soraka.name: Wish
Soraka.text: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

Soraka.name: Salvation
Soraka.text: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

Jade_Graves.name: Buckshot
Jade_Graves.text: Graves fires three bullets in a cone, damaging all enemies in their paths.

Jade_Graves.name: Smoke Screen
Jade_Graves.text: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke. Enemies inside the smoke cloud have reduced sight range and Movement Speed.

Jade_Graves.name: Quickdraw
Jade_Graves.text: Graves dashes forward gaining an Attack Speed boost for several seconds. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill.

Jade_Graves.name: Collateral Damage
Jade_Graves.text: Graves fires an explosive shell that deals heavy damage to units it hits or passes through. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.

Jade_Graves.name: True Grit
Jade_Graves.text: Graves gains increasing armor and magic resistance the longer he remains in combat.

Senna.name: Piercing Darkness
Senna.text: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.

Senna.name: Last Embrace
Senna.text: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.

Senna.name: Curse of the Black Mist
Senna.text: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

Senna.name: Dawning Shadow
Senna.text: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

Senna.name: Absolution
Senna.text: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

Jade_Caitlyn.name: Piltover Peacemaker
Jade_Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn unleashes a penetrating shot that damages all enemies in a line.

Jade_Caitlyn.name: Yordle Snap Trap
Jade_Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn sets a trap to find sneaky yordles. When sprung by a champion, the trap immobilizes, reveals, and damages them over a short duration.

Jade_Caitlyn.name: 90 Caliber Net
Jade_Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

Jade_Caitlyn.name: Ace in the Hole
Jade_Caitlyn.text: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to an enemy champion at a huge range. Other enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

Jade_Caitlyn.name: Headshot
Jade_Caitlyn.text: Every few basic attacks, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing extra damage.

Jade_Kayle.name: Reckoning
Jade_Kayle.text: Kayle blasts a target, dealing damage, slowing their movement speed, and applying a stack of Holy Fervor.

Jade_Kayle.name: Divine Blessing
Jade_Kayle.text: Kayle blesses an allied champion, increasing their movement speed and healing them.

Jade_Kayle.name: Righteous Fury
Jade_Kayle.text: Kayle increases her attack range and her basic attacks deals additional damage to her target and nearby enemies.

Jade_Kayle.name: Intervention
Jade_Kayle.text: Bathes Kayle's target in a holy light, rendering them immune to all damage for a short time.

Jade_Kayle.name: Holy Fervor
Jade_Kayle.text: Kayle gains a percentage of her Ability Power as Attack damage and a percentage of her Attack Damage as Ability Power.

Kindred.name: Dance of Arrows
Kindred.text: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.

Kindred.name: Wolf's Frenzy
Kindred.text: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him.  Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.

Kindred.name: Mounting Dread
Kindred.text: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.

Kindred.name: Lamb's Respite
Kindred.text: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

Kindred.name: Mark of the Kindred
Kindred.text: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

Maokai.name: Bramble Smash
Maokai.text: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

Maokai.name: Twisted Advance
Maokai.text: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

Maokai.name: Sapling Toss
Maokai.text: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

Maokai.name: Nature's Grasp
Maokai.text: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

Maokai.name: Sap Magic
Maokai.text: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

Katarina.name: Bouncing Blade
Katarina.text: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.

Katarina.name: Preparation
Katarina.text: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.

Katarina.name: Shunpo
Katarina.text: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.

Katarina.name: Death Lotus
Katarina.text: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.

Katarina.name: Voracity
Katarina.text: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

Jade_Soraka.name: Starcall
Jade_Soraka.text: A shower of stars falls from the sky, striking all nearby enemies for magic damage and reducing their Magic Resist for a short duration.

Jade_Soraka.name: Astral Blessing
Jade_Soraka.text: Soraka blesses a friendly unit, restoring health and increasing Armor for a short time.

Jade_Soraka.name: Infuse
Jade_Soraka.text: Restores Mana to an ally, or deals damage to an enemy and silences them for a short duration.

Jade_Soraka.name: Wish
Jade_Soraka.text: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all friendly champions.

Yasuo.name: Steel Tempest
Yasuo.text: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne.Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.

Yasuo.name: Wind Wall
Yasuo.text: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

Yasuo.name: Sweeping Blade
Yasuo.text: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount.Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds.If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.

Yasuo.name: Last Breath
Yasuo.text: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm.For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.

Yasuo.name: Way of the Wanderer
Yasuo.text: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.

Vladimir.name: Transfusion
Vladimir.text: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

Vladimir.name: Sanguine Pool
Vladimir.text: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

Vladimir.name: Tides of Blood
Vladimir.text: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

Vladimir.name: Hemoplague
Vladimir.text: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

Vladimir.name: Crimson Pact
Vladimir.text: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

Jade_Leona.name: Shield of Daybreak
Jade_Leona.text: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

Jade_Leona.name: Eclipse
Jade_Leona.text: Leona raises her shield to gain Armor and Magic Resistance.  When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

Jade_Leona.name: Zenith Blade
Jade_Leona.text: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

Jade_Leona.name: Solar Flare
Jade_Leona.text: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area.  Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

Jade_Leona.name: Sunlight
Jade_Leona.text: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight debuff to deal additional damage.

Jade_Lucian.name: Piercing Light
Jade_Lucian.text: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

Jade_Lucian.name: Ardent Blaze
Jade_Lucian.text: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking enemies. Lucian gains Movement Speed for attacking marked enemies.

Jade_Lucian.name: Relentless Pursuit
Jade_Lucian.text: Lucian dashes a short distance, removing all slow effects.

Jade_Lucian.name: The Culling
Jade_Lucian.text: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

Jade_Lucian.name: Lightslinger
Jade_Lucian.text: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot.

Mordekaiser.name: Obliterate
Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

Mordekaiser.name: Indestructible
Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

Mordekaiser.name: Death's Grasp
Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

Mordekaiser.name: Realm of Death
Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

Mordekaiser.name: Darkness Rise
Mordekaiser.text: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

Gwen.name: Snip Snip!
Gwen.text: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

Gwen.name: Hallowed Mist
Gwen.text: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

Gwen.name: Skip 'n Slash
Gwen.text: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

Gwen.name: Needlework
Gwen.text: Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit. This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

Gwen.name: A Thousand Cuts
Gwen.text: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

Jade_Fiora.name: Lunge
Jade_Fiora.text: Fiora dashes forward to strike her target, dealing physical damage. Fiora can perform the dash a second time within a couple of seconds at no Mana cost.

Jade_Fiora.name: Riposte
Jade_Fiora.text: Fiora's Attack Damage is increased. When activated, Fiora parries the next basic attack and reflects magic damage back to the attacker. Works against champions, monsters, and large minions.

Jade_Fiora.name: Burst of Speed
Jade_Fiora.text: Fiora temporarily gains additional Attack Speed. Each attack or Lunge she lands during this time increases her Movement Speed. Killing a champion refreshes the cooldown on this ability.

Jade_Fiora.name: Blade Waltz
Jade_Fiora.text: Fiora dashes around the battlefield to deal physical damage to enemy champions. Successive strikes against the same target deal less damage.

Jade_Fiora.name: Duelist
Jade_Fiora.text: Fiora regenerates Health over time when she deals damage. Striking champions will cause this effect to stack multiple times.

Anivia.name: Flash Frost
Anivia.text: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

Anivia.name: Crystallize
Anivia.text: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

Anivia.name: Frostbite
Anivia.text: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.

Anivia.name: Glacial Storm
Anivia.text: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

Anivia.name: Rebirth
Anivia.text: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

Jade_Chogath.name: Rupture
Jade_Chogath.text: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

Jade_Chogath.name: Feral Scream
Jade_Chogath.text: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

Jade_Chogath.name: Vorpal Spikes
Jade_Chogath.text: Cho'Gath's attacks passively release deadly spikes, dealing damage to all enemy units in front of him.

Jade_Chogath.name: Feast
Jade_Chogath.text: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum health (maximum 6 stacks). Cho'Gath loses half of his stacks upon death.

Jade_Chogath.name: Carnivore
Jade_Chogath.text: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers health and mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

Camille.name: Precision Protocol
Camille.text: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

Camille.name: Tactical Sweep
Camille.text: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

Camille.name: Hookshot
Camille.text: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

Camille.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
Camille.text: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

Camille.name: Adaptive Defenses
Camille.text: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

Leona.name: Shield of Daybreak
Leona.text: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

Leona.name: Eclipse
Leona.text: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

Leona.name: Zenith Blade
Leona.text: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

Leona.name: Solar Flare
Leona.text: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

Leona.name: Sunlight
Leona.text: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

Karthus.name: Lay Waste
Karthus.text: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Deals increased damage to isolated enemies.

Karthus.name: Wall of Pain
Karthus.text: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy. Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Move Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.

Karthus.name: Defile
Karthus.text: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill. Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own Mana.

Karthus.name: Requiem
Karthus.text: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.

Karthus.name: Death Defied
Karthus.text: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.

Jade_Gangplank.name: Parrrley
Jade_Gangplank.text: Gangplank takes aim and shoots an enemy unit with his pistol. If Parrrley deals a killing blow, he gains extra gold and half the mana cost is refunded.

Jade_Gangplank.name: Remove Scurvy
Jade_Gangplank.text: Consumes a large quantity of citrus fruit which clears any crowd control effects on him and heals him.

Jade_Gangplank.name: Raise Morale
Jade_Gangplank.text: Gangplank fires a shot into the air, increasing nearby allied champions' attack damage and movement speed.

Jade_Gangplank.name: Cannon Barrage
Jade_Gangplank.text: Gangplank signals his ship to fire upon an area anywhere on the map, slowing enemies and dealing damage over time.

Jade_Gangplank.name: Grog-Soaked Blade
Jade_Gangplank.text: Gangplank's attacks apply a poison that deals magic damage per second, increasing with level.

Quinn.name: Blinding Assault
Quinn.text: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.

Quinn.name: Heightened Senses
Quinn.text: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.

Quinn.name: Vault
Quinn.text: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.

Quinn.name: Behind Enemy Lines
Quinn.text: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.

Quinn.name: Harrier
Quinn.text: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with Harrier. Quinn's first basic attack against Harrier targets will deal bonus physical damage.

Jade_Nautilus.name: Dredge Line
Jade_Nautilus.text: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits a champion, he drags both himself and the opponent close together. If it hits terrain, Nautilus instead pulls himself to the anchor and the cooldown of Dredge Line is reduced.

Jade_Nautilus.name: Titan's Wrath
Jade_Nautilus.text: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield.  While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.

Jade_Nautilus.name: Riptide
Jade_Nautilus.text: Nautilus slams the ground, causing the earth to explode around him in a set of three explosions. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.

Jade_Nautilus.name: Depth Charge
Jade_Nautilus.text: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

Jade_Nautilus.name: Staggering Blow
Jade_Nautilus.text: Nautilus' basic attacks deal bonus physical damage and immoblize his targets. This effect cannot happen more than once every few seconds on the same target.

Jade_Singed.name: Poison Trail
Jade_Singed.text: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

Jade_Singed.name: Mega Adhesive
Jade_Singed.text: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing enemies who walk on it.

Jade_Singed.name: Fling
Jade_Singed.text: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed.

Jade_Singed.name: Insanity Potion
Jade_Singed.text: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats.

Jade_Singed.name: Empowered Bulwark
Jade_Singed.text: Increases Singed's Health based on his maximum Mana.

Olaf.name: Undertow
Olaf.text: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

Olaf.name: Tough It Out
Olaf.text: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

Olaf.name: Reckless Swing
Olaf.text: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

Olaf.name: Ragnarok
Olaf.text: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

Olaf.name: Berserker Rage
Olaf.text: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

Jade_Teemo.name: Blinding Dart
Jade_Teemo.text: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

Jade_Teemo.name: Move Quick
Jade_Teemo.text: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his movement speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret.  Teemo can sprint to gain bonus movement speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

Jade_Teemo.name: Toxic Shot
Jade_Teemo.text: Each of Teemo's attacks poisons the target, dealing damage on impact and over time.

Jade_Teemo.name: Noxious Trap
Jade_Teemo.text: Teemo places an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack.  If an enemy steps on the trap it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time.

Jade_Teemo.name: Camouflage
Jade_Teemo.text: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

DrMundo.name: Infected Bonesaw
DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw, dealing damage to the first enemy hit based on their current health and slowing them.

DrMundo.name: Heart Zapper
DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo electrocutes himself, dealing persistent damage to nearby enemies and storing a portion of damage he takes. At the end of the duration or on Recast, Dr. Mundo deals a burst of damage to nearby enemies. If the burst hit an enemy, he heals a percentage of the stored damage.

DrMundo.name: Blunt Force Trauma
DrMundo.text: Passive - Dr. Mundo gains bonus Attack Damage, increasing based on his max Health.Active - Dr. Mundo slams his “medical” bag into an enemy, dealing additional damage based on his missing Health. If the enemy dies they are swatted away, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.

DrMundo.name: Maximum Dosage
DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, instantly healing a percent of his missing Health. He then gains Move Speed and regenerates a portion of his maximum Health over a long duration.

DrMundo.name: Goes Where He Pleases
DrMundo.text: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown.Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.

Jade_Sivir.name: Boomerang Blade
Jade_Sivir.text: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

Jade_Sivir.name: Ricochet
Jade_Sivir.text: Sivir's next basic attack will bounce between targets, dealing reduced damage with each successive hit.

Jade_Sivir.name: Spell Shield
Jade_Sivir.text: Sivir creates a magical barrier on herself that blocks a single enemy ability. She regains Mana if an ability is successfully blocked.

Jade_Sivir.name: On The Hunt
Jade_Sivir.text: Sivir leads her allies into battle granting them increased Movement and Attack Speeds for a period of time.

Jade_Sivir.name: Fleet of Foot
Jade_Sivir.text: Sivir gains a short burst of Movement Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

Jade_Warwick.name: Hungering Strike
Jade_Warwick.text: Takes a bite out of an enemy unit and heals Warwick.

Jade_Warwick.name: Hunter's Call
Jade_Warwick.text: Warwick lets out a howl, increasing all friendly champions' Attack Speed for a short time.

Jade_Warwick.name: Blood Scent
Jade_Warwick.text: Warwick passively senses weakened enemy champions around him.  The scent of blood sends him into a fury, causing him to move at incredible speeds.

Jade_Warwick.name: Infinite Duress
Jade_Warwick.text: Warwick lunges at an enemy champion, suppressing his target and dealing magic damage for a few seconds.

Jade_Warwick.name: Eternal Thirst
Jade_Warwick.text: Each of Warwick's attacks will heal him. Each successive attack against the same target will steal more and more Health.

Jade_Quinn.name: Blinding Assault
Jade_Quinn.text: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path, damaging and blinding all enemies near that point.

Jade_Quinn.name: Heightened Senses
Jade_Quinn.text: Passive as Quinn: Gain attack and move speed for a few seconds when triggering Harrier.Passive as Valor: Gain attack speed.Active: Reveal a large area around Quinn and Valor.

Jade_Quinn.name: Vault
Jade_Quinn.text: Quinn or Valor dashes to an enemy, dealing damage, knocking back, and slowing their target. If cast as Quinn, she then vaults off of them, keeping her distance while Valor marks them with Harrier.

Jade_Quinn.name: Tag Team
Jade_Quinn.text: Valor replaces Quinn on the battlefield as a mobile melee attacker, gaining movement speed and modifying her abilities. Cast again to perform Skystrike, damaging all nearby enemies.

Jade_Quinn.name: Harrier
Jade_Quinn.text: Valor periodically marks enemies as Vulnerable, whom Quinn can attack to deal bonus damage.

Nautilus.name: Dredge Line
Nautilus.text: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward.  Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage.  Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.

Nautilus.name: Titan's Wrath
Nautilus.text: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield.  While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.

Nautilus.name: Riptide
Nautilus.text: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.

Nautilus.name: Depth Charge
Nautilus.text: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

Nautilus.name: Staggering Blow
Nautilus.text: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

Jade_Blitzcrank.name: Rocket Grab
Jade_Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

Jade_Blitzcrank.name: Overdrive
Jade_Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank supercharges themself to get dramatically increased movement and attack speed.

Jade_Blitzcrank.name: Power Fist
Jade_Blitzcrank.text: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make their next attack deal bonus damage and pop their target up in the air.

Jade_Blitzcrank.name: Static Field
Jade_Blitzcrank.text: Passively causes lightning bolts to damage a nearby enemy. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to damage nearby enemies and briefly silence them.

Jade_Blitzcrank.name: Mana Barrier
Jade_Blitzcrank.text: When taking damage at low Health, Blitzcrank is first Shielded for a percent of their current Mana. This effect has a cooldown.

Nocturne.name: Duskbringer
Nocturne.text: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

Nocturne.name: Shroud of Darkness
Nocturne.text: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

Nocturne.name: Unspeakable Horror
Nocturne.text: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

Nocturne.name: Paranoia
Nocturne.text: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

Nocturne.name: Umbra Blades
Nocturne.text: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

Sejuani.name: Arctic Assault
Sejuani.text: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.

Sejuani.name: Winter's Wrath
Sejuani.text: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.

Sejuani.name: Permafrost
Sejuani.text: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.

Sejuani.name: Glacial Prison
Sejuani.text: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.

Sejuani.name: Fury of the North
Sejuani.text: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage.  Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.

Jade_MasterYi.name: Alpha Strike
Jade_MasterYi.text: Master Yi leaps across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path. Alpha strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to minions and monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

Jade_MasterYi.name: Meditate
Jade_MasterYi.text: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.

Jade_MasterYi.name: Wuju Style
Jade_MasterYi.text: Master Yi becomes skilled in the art of Wuju, passively increasing his Attack Damage.  Activating Wuju Style grants bonus true damage on basic attacks, but the passive bonus is then lost while on cooldown.

Jade_MasterYi.name: Highlander
Jade_MasterYi.text: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Movement and Attack speeds as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extends Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

Rumble.name: Flamespitter
